One of the things that deeply concerns me is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

**It’s for this reason that the recent revival of the famed New York Sun is so vital.**

It’s nice to meet you, friend!
My name is Jacky Rosen. I’m Nevada’s junior Senator and I’m running for reelection in 2024’s most important swing state.

Let me tell you a little bit about myself:
💜 I’m the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants, the daughter of a WWII veteran, and I come from an extended family of proud union workers.

💜 I’m the only Jewish woman serving in the Senate and the only former synagogue president in Senate history.

💜 And in 2018, I flipped a highly competitive Senate seat from red to blue.

name: David
subject: TikTok Ban - What’s Next?
body:
The buzz about banning TikTok has kicked off a crucial conversation on how technology intersects with our privacy and freedom. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/tiktok-ban-whats-next?e=fee98d637f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friends,

In this era of breakneck tech evolution and societal shifts, I've been pondering what this journey means for us and the road ahead. The buzz about banning TikTok has kicked off a crucial conversation on how technology intersects with our privacy and freedom. This debate hits right at the heart of what we believe in and the kind of forward-thinking, inclusive society we aim to build.

Sifting through the ocean of data, opinions, and, yes, sometimes misinformation, it's crucial we stick to our core values: fairness, justice, and the firm belief in our collective power to drive change. My thoughts on the TikTok issue, as you've likely already seen, go beyond just one app. It's about our broader approach to the digital era's challenges.

But here's the kicker: the moment talk turns to clamping down on TikTok, action is swift. Yet, when we demand transformative measures like Medicare for All, progress grinds to a halt. Why? Because the policymakers, those supposed to serve our interests, are too often in the pockets of big corporations and special interests. Their priorities? Whatever fills their coffers, not what saves lives or improves them. It's time to expose this charade for what it is: a system rigged to benefit the wealthy, leaving the rest of us to fend for ourselves.

We stand at a juncture where the decisions we make will shape the legacy we leave for future generations. We have the opportunity to safeguard our national security, while also pushing for bold policy changes that truly make a difference in people's lives. Together, let's embrace this moment with the knowledge that we can shape a future that reflects our highest ideals and our deepest values.

**_How You Can Be Part of This Journey_**

I invite you to join me in this ongoing conversation, to delve deeper into these issues, and to lend your voice to shaping a future that aligns with our shared values:
* **Educate Yourself and Others:** [Visit our accountability resource page](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=16ea9e5855&e=fee98d637f), where you can track where your Representative’s money is coming from and what bills they support. Engage with the resources we’ve compiled, and share this knowledge within your circles. An informed community is the bedrock of meaningful change.
* **Participate in Dialogue:** Your thoughts, experiences, and insights are invaluable. Join our forums, attend our virtual town halls, and let’s have a constructive dialogue about the future of technology and policy.
* **Support Our Cause:** If you believe in this vision, I encourage you to support our campaign in any way you can. Whether it’s through volunteering your time, contributing financially, or simply spreading the word, your support is what fuels this movement.

In the spirit of great leaders before us, let us approach these challenges with courage, compassion, and a relentless pursuit of what is just and right. Together, we can chart a course through the digital landscape that honors our past while boldly embracing our future.

Thank you for your unwavering support and for standing alongside me in this crucial moment. Let’s continue to dream, to fight, and to build a world that reflects our highest aspirations.

Onward,
David

body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/64707?t=6&akid=13544%2E878179%2EEtj44O) Friend, it's official: the general election is here!

I couldn't be more honored to represent the people of Ohio and have the opportunity to keep fighting for the Dignity of Work in the Senate. I want to personally thank every member of this team – including you, friend – for powering our grassroots movement this far.

All we have accomplished together so far makes it clearer than ever, Ohio voters want someone who will fight for them in the Senate. Better wages and working conditions, reproductive freedom, affordable housing and health care – I promise to keep up these critical fights for all of us.

But our real fight starts now, friend. We now have an official opponent, Bernie Moreno, and he's a deep-pocketed Donald Trump ally that's ready to spend millions of dollars to try to buy this seat. Polls show this race is neck and neck, Republicans are already spending record-breaking sums to defeat me and flip the Senate red, and it's only going to get worse.

[So I'm personally asking: Will you split $10 or more right now between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to make sure we have the resources to fight back against GOP attacks, protect this seat, and keep the Senate blue?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/64708?t=7&akid=13544%2E878179%2EEtj44O) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sherrod Brown and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/64709?t=8&akid=13544%2E878179%2EEtj44O)

Sherrod Brown

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, Our 2nd Amendment rights are under attack at the Capitol this week, [get in touch with your State Representative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or to find out how to testify or engage. “You know why there's a Second Amendment? In case the government fails to follow the first one.” – Rush Limbaugh This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, March 20, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**‘Assault weapons’ bill, opposed by hundreds in 12-hour marathon hearing, advances in House**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Hundreds of Coloradans provided a master’s course on the Founding Fathers, the Federalist Papers and the U.S. Constitution Tuesday in opposition to House Bill 1292, but it was to no avail. The presentation of the bill, by Democratic Reps. Elisabeth Epps and Tim Hernandez, to the House Judiciary Committee drew pro-gun advocates to call it an “all out war” and “infringement” on gun owners, and to instead call for hardening of targets at schools throughout Colorado. A bill they say was written by special interests, ignores personal responsibility, could shutdown gun shops throughout the state, and is an unconstitutional overreach of power to restrict common use firearms from law-abiding Coloradans, the House Judiciary Committee was told repeatedly. The bill titled “Prohibit Certain Weapons Used in Mass Shootings,” is not that at all, Republican Rep. Ryan Armagost said, with him and others indicating the bill is an extreme measure to restrict ownership of pistols and long guns from law-abiding citizens by Democrats. “At least every paragraph, maybe every sentence uses the term ‘assault weapon’. Why don’t we just change the bill title to ‘Assault Weapons ban’?” Armagost asked. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**COMMENTARY: Open letter to the sponsors of SB24-091, and members of the Joint Technology Committee**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Cory Gaines, a resident of Logan County, Colorado, emphasizes the limitations faced by individuals [without broadband](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including restricted educational opportunities, limited access to full-time jobs with benefits, and reduced economic growth.

* Gaines discusses [Senate Bill 24-091](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), expressing frustration at its repeated tabling, attributing it to financial interests and excessive fees proposed by lawmakers. He advocates for reasonable fees in legislation to facilitate the expansion of high-speed internet access, particularly in smaller communities where profit incentives alone may not suffice.

* Gaines urges policymakers to prioritize equitable access to broadband internet to foster economic development and job opportunities in rural areas like Logan County.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
[**Study: Colorado ban on oil and gas drilling will take a toll on education, destroy jobs, cut GDP**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Senate Bill 24-159](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aiming to halt new oil and gas drilling permits by 2030, faces criticism from the Common Sense Institute (CSI) researchers, who warn of catastrophic economic consequences.

* The CSI report estimates that the bill could result in the loss of over 181,800 jobs, $2 billion in state and local tax revenue, and a decrease of over $400 million in school funding over a decade. It also projects [significant losses in state GDP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* Critics argue that the bill fails to consider the potential increase in CO2 emissions and the likelihood of companies leaving Colorado, ultimately challenging the feasibility of ongoing oil and gas production without new drilling.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Douglas County aims to challenge Colorado’s sanctuary laws amid illegal immigration surge in Denver**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Douglas County commissioners are considering a legal challenge [against Colorado's sanctuary laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) due to a surge in illegal immigration, aiming to fully cooperate with federal law enforcement.

* They have advanced an ordinance preventing commercial buses from unloading passengers at unplanned destinations to deter immigrants from arriving unannounced.

* Surrounding counties and cities, including [Douglas County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), are taking measures to avoid sanctuary status, reflecting concerns about bearing the financial burden seen in Denver. Proposed measures include fines for unloading passengers at unplanned locations.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Fentanyl found on chartered bus Colorado 4th-grade students were on**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[CBS 11 KKTV](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Fentanyl was discovered on a chartered bus [transporting elementary-aged students](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a Colorado school district, prompting concerns and reminders for parents to discuss drugs with their children.

* The source of the drugs on the bus remains unclear, and the school district has not identified the bus company involved. Colorado Springs Police Department responded to the incident, recovering over [60 pills believed to be fentanyl](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with no arrests made due to lack of probable cause.

* District 60 issued a statement emphasizing student safety and notifying parents and guardians of the incident, urging them to speak with their children and report any pills found to the police. Ramblin Express, the bus company involved, stated that the bus was thoroughly cleaned before the trip, and the driver discovered the pills after completing the charter, prompting immediate notification to authorities and the school district.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** [**Libertarians will gather for party’s convention March 23-24 in Colorado Springs**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MARCH 20** _The Colorado Libertarian Party’s Convention is Saturday-Sunday, March 23-24, in Colorado Springs at the Masonic Center, 1150 Panorama Dr._ [**Plea deal gives former producer at Sounds True lenient sentence for possession of 6,000 images of sexual child abuse**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | BOULDER COUNTY | MARCH 18** _Mitchell Clute, 57, a former senior producer and editor at Sounds True, has agreed to a plea deal, according to various media reports, on charges of possessing and distributing child sexual abuse material._ **[Ahead of Tuesday deadline, only three have sufficiently met signature threshold for a place on ballot for Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MARCH 18** _Signatures needed to petition for a place on the primary ballot has been met by just three candidates for Congress to have pulled a petition, a report by the office of the Colorado secretary of state reads._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)[@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!

subject: Condemning our state’s SB4 for the racist law it is / Condenando la SB4 de nuestro estado por la ley racista que es
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Gov. Abbott and our courts are playing with Texans' lives
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SB4.jpg]
The political back-and-forth with our state's SB4 [https://www.aclutx.org/en/know-your-rights/know-your-rights-under-texas-deportation-scheme-sb4] continues. Early Tuesday afternoon, the Supreme Court ruled to allow the enforcement of SB4, our state’s new law targeting migrant communities, pitching the case back to the 5th Circuit Court of Appeals. Then, late Tuesday night, a three-judge panel at the 5th Circuit Court of Appeals blocked the law once again. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sb4-texas-immigration-law-blocked-again-after-supreme-court-allowed-state-to-arrest-migrants/]
This jeopardizing of human lives must stop. SB4 is white supremacy in action that emboldens racial profiling, attacks personal freedoms, and directly threatens the well-being of our state's immigrant families. This disgusting law was only designed to sow division and fear in Texas communities, not enhance public safety. TOP continues our fight for justice and the rights of ALL people across Texas.
At its core, SB4 further codifies discrimination and endangers lives in our state. This is the future that today's increasingly white nationalist Texas GOP wants. We're not cowering in the face of their extremism, though. TOP and our strategic partners remain dead set on utilizing every organizing and legal tool at our disposal to combat and fully stop this egregious law.
We need you in the fight against SB4. Call or text TOP Immigration Lead Organizer Damaris Gonzalez at 832-774-7704 to find out how you can plug in to our efforts.
When Hip-Hop, organizing, and housing justice collide
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hip%20Hop%20Cultural%20Caravan.jpeg]
No matter your age, race, or income level, ALL Texans deserve a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home. It’s the foundation of TOP’s housing justice organizing.
That organizing was combined with music this past week, as we raised the roof for affordable green social housing for ALL in the Lone Star State! Teaming up with movement partners Center for Popular Democracy (CPD) and VOCAL-TX, TOP co-hosted the Cultural Caravan Festival, featuring some of the most progressive, powerful voices in Hip-Hop today.
Dead Prez [https://www.deadprez.com/] , Kemba [https://www.instagram.com/kembaland/] , and other up-and-coming artists made stops in San Antonio (March 12), Austin (March 14), and Houston (March 17).
Read the write-up of the Houston performance here. [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/article/artists-gather-sunnyside-concert-advocating-19169584.php]
For more about this Cultural Caravan, and how it ties into TOP's housing justice organizing, email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
Another TOP statewide staff meeting in the books
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202024%20staff%20group%20pic.jpg]
TOP held an in-person statewide meeting Tuesday and Wednesday this week featuring staff from our three county offices — Harris, Dallas and Bexar.
This convening was rooted in building connections as a team and grounding ourselves for the busy months ahead as we make our way through 2024.
We reflected on our successes, challenges, and recommitted ourselves to sharpening strategy for our campaigns so that we can win even more for our communities this year, while setting the stage for a successful 2025.

El gobernador Abbott y nuestro sistema judicial están jugando con las vidas de los tejanos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SB4.jpg]
El tira y afloja político con la SB4 [https://www.aclutx.org/en/know-your-rights/know-your-rights-under-texas-deportation-scheme-sb4] de nuestro estado continúa. A primera hora de la tarde del martes, la Corte Suprema falló a el favor de permitir la aplicación de la SB4, la nueva ley de nuestro estado dirigida a las comunidades de inmigrantes, y devolvió el caso a la Corte de Apelaciones del Quinto Circuito. Luego, el martes por la noche, un panel de tres jueces del Tribunal de Apelaciones del Quinto Circuito bloqueó la ley una vez más. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sb4-texas-immigration-law-blocked-again-after-supreme-court-allowed-state-to-arrest-migrants/]
El riesgo de vidas humanas debe parar. La SB4 es la supremacía blanca en acción que permite la discriminación racial, ataca las libertades personales y amenaza directamente el bienestar de las familias inmigrantes de nuestro estado. Esta repugnante ley sólo fue diseñada para sembrar división y sufrimiento en las comunidades de Texas, no para mejorar la seguridad pública. TOP continúa nuestra lucha por la justicia y los derechos de TODAS las personas en Texas.
En esencia, la SB4 codifica aún más la discriminación y pone en peligro vidas en nuestro estado. Éste es el futuro que hoy quiere el Partido Republicano de Texas, cada vez más nacionalista y blanco. Sin embargo, no nos acobardamos ante su extremismo. TOP y nuestros socios siguen decididos a utilizar todas las herramientas jurídicas y organizativas a nuestra disposición para combatir y detener por completo esta ley atras.
Te necesitamos en la lucha contra SB4. Llame o envíe un mensaje de texto a Damaris Gonzalez, organizadora principal de inmigración de TOP, al 832-774-7704 para descubrir cómo puede unirse a nuestros esfuerzos.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hip%20Hop%20Cultural%20Caravan.jpeg]
No importa su edad, raza o nivel de ingresos, TODOS los tejanos merecen un lugar seguro, estable y asequible al que llamar hogar. Es la base de la organización de justicia de vivienda de TOP.
¡Esa organización se combinó con música la semana pasada, mientras levantamos el techo para viviendas sociales ecológicas asequibles para TODOS en el Estado de la Estrella Solitaria! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202024%20staff%20group%20pic.jpg]
TOP celebró una reunión estatal en persona el martes y miércoles de esta semana con el personal de nuestras tres oficinas del condado: Harris, Dallas, y Bexar.

Steve Thompson, Editor

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel for decades.

They’ve been waiting for an anti-gun President, like Joe Biden, to take the White House **so they can launch an all-out effort to ratify it in the U.S. Senate**.

Now, they think they finally see their opportunity to _ram it through_!

But you and I have a chance to stop them cold -- **[as long as we take IMMEDIATE action to help dismantle this dangerous Treaty](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms4tqdbnwcoserb5h8lkbb4fghekej711s1ujm0aid9watejxn7diubo4tijf6gtt2zo4qfjly7sjdri5ub2clifr0xh0ch5mev4gyylom5ve48wrx53x0pt5ae4cstfemkzoso9cs804giq7w7wpbe0t08d6r1wjy5nemvm63jb1&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sap7y9)**.

As Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the email below, it’s absolutely critical we act now!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,
**“BIDEN AIMS TO SIGN ON TO UN'S GLOBAL GUN REGISTRATION TREATY.”**
That was the headline in the _Washington Examiner_ shortly after President Biden’s State Department spokesman told international bureaucrats of “the continuing commitment of the United States” to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” during the gun control Conference of State Parties in Geneva, Switzerland.

Just a few weeks later, President Biden himself spoke before the United Nations in New York City, stating: _“We’ll continue to uphold the long-standing rules and norms... Bedrock commitments,**like support for arms control measures** to reduce the risk and enhance transparency.”_ Fellow Patriot, anyone hoping that President Biden wouldn’t use his bully pulpit to RAM the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” down the throats of Americans just got those hopes CRUSHED.

The battle over implementation of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- the crown jewel in the gun grabbers’ designs for the globe -- is about to reach a fever pitch.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms4tqdbnwcoserb5h8lkbb4fghk3c8vc2sqr3pih044fzh6k9vktx8bmge0pogtn1ymop1yb9dp58sqv4ad0srjixcd1mpef5k1kt1xffv9qmrtax85bo54j8kezgnah5fcyke22g2xidduj8aifz0nvpyayvlmj0ghvqwrhgn8f2&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sap7y9)**!

As you’ll see, this survey insists that your U.S. Senators do everything in their power to oppose the UN “Small Arms Treaty” in the U.S. Senate.

_If there’s anything we’ve learned, it’s that globalists have been telling LIES about the supposed “need’ for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” for years_.

From the beginning, gun grabbers have claimed the purpose of the Treaty is keeping arms out of the hands of terrorists, insurgents, rogue states, and gang members.

But at the very same time the Biden Administration was pledging their support for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty,” they were leaving $83 BILLION in U.S. military weaponry to the Taliban!

They don’t care about keeping guns out of the hands of terrorists.

_They care about keeping guns out of the hands of law-abiding Americans_!

Reading through the details of the UN “Small Arms Treaty,” it’s hard to see how our Second Amendment could survive, if ratified.

For starters, the Treaty text demands the U.S. identify “end users” (gun buyers), document “the quantity, value, and model/type” of firearms and ammunition, and develop “national control standards” to regulate transfers.

_In other words, by design it’s an International Gun Registry that’ll include detailed information on American gun owners just like you -- the first step toward outright CONFISCATION_.

Worse, all that information would be made accessible by despots and foreign governments including the Treaty's largest signer -- Communist China.

**[As you can see, it’s vital you sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators demanding they reject this scheme](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms4tqdbnwcoserb5h8lkbb4fgi38zvir3sdn9tf13t02z8wkjeb79kb9x23eiu44y5joxarsviufv5p63gek5hklesi7w0ct13we3swamep8eccech6n39ipo8f6k6hivouyx3dhjalfqa5s9fy2imh2m94tjvw943xd0gotuuvji&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sap7y9)**!

Introductory language already includes: *** _Mandated national “screening” for those seeking to own guns_ , giving bureaucrats the final say on whether or not you’re “competent” enough to own a firearm; *** _Restrictive licensing for gun and ammo sales_ , and perhaps even bans on anything from semi-auto rifles to shotguns and handguns; *** _Restrictions on the number of guns and amount of ammo any “properly-licensed” individual may legally own_ ; *** _Bans on magazines holding more than ten rounds_ ; and *** _Bans on owning a firearm for self-defense_ \-- unless a citizen can somehow get government approval (which will only happen if you’re “connected” -- or paid half-a-million dollars for one of Hunter Biden’s paintings). Believe me, the United Nations has no intention of slow walking any of this.

To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand “utopian” designs.

Enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they’re pouring money into the UN “Small Arms Treaty” hand-over-fist.

_So, it’s no wonder why they’re hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it_!

**[I’m counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms4tqdbnwcoserb5h8lkbb4fh1eba6087h321fvefdc1k45bhupccgzge9j2cdslrlty70pdfyffqhgb6wkqrb6v9uz69u4lz8tb03mvsiz558hr0rgt8wq8lpqr8gbrw7y7q4s7kws2gj6xv1ap80w2v6dp01jabec7dgwwqyipb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sap7y9)**.

As soon the gun grabbers have 67 votes to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate, you can bet Biden’s pal, Sen. Chuck Schumer, will call for the vote.

But we can’t wait until then to fight back because even now, one-world bureaucrats are pushing these gun controls deep into every part of government.

_On top of Biden’s ATF anti-gun executive actions, a headline from _The Hill_ shows how “Democrats’ latest backdoor plan to limit gun ownership” involves new State Department “sanctions” designed to drive the price of ammo by BANNING imports_.

That’s the same State Department which NAGR caught red-handed trying to siphon your tax dollars into funding the UN “Small Arms Treaty.”

_Worse, since day one of the COVID-19 outbreak, our court system has said yes to almost any politician cooking up any unconstitutional idea so long as it’s under the guise of “public health_.”

So now Biden’s Center for Disease Control (CDC) is pushing a new Euro-centric gun control framework that says _“Using a public health approach is essential to addressing firearm violence and keeping people safe and healthy.”_

That’s why insisting that your U.S. Senators OPPOSE the ratification of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” is not enough.

We must insist that the U.S. Senate ensures that NOT ONE TAXPAYER CENT is spent by Biden on implementing any part of this Treaty or what it stands for.

But I’m counting on your help to send that message -- before it’s too late.

**[First, please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms4tqdbnwcoserb5h8lkbb4fh1jgxtoj8hrk7jrkj4xmjtvcvd4srwzfuw0umr3f0v4yrz6v3dltbwfo5d0o557ys8eov52zuq0uyu9pk5clzw4v62h2lb5b2zqkobisjcq70s6126fltff4w6pytn3xrf78py70f1srq4t62g7tb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sap7y9)**.

Second, please agree to your most generous contribution to help the National Association for Gun Rights mobilize a grassroots firestorm against the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- using everything from _U.S. Mail_ , to _phones_ , to _email_ , _blogs_ , and _guest editorials_ , _hard-hitting video_ and even _paid media_ if we can raise resources.

If at all possible, I’m hoping you’ll agree to $100.

body:
I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbs1vqgoeoo51pael60gncarp4s8llpp2eec0ur8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c1i6aoj6c3h2bs)

| |
Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I’m reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like “ _Does God exist? Can we know God?_ ” with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human – both in our relationship with each other and with God. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeidv6eb3fioebmre3000slpdqv1hab7rq0vd8oo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34c1i6aoj6c3h2bs)

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

name: David Nammo, Christian Legal Society
subject: State Department rule violates religious beliefs
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper._WVvcAoc6B8605hrtoWug)
---
Fellow American, Christian relief organizations are in the crosshairs of the U.S. State Department ...__**_BECAUSE_ of their Christian faith!** **[**Will you stand with Christian Legal Society in support of faith-based relief organizations today? Add your name to our urgent open letter to the U.S. State Department.**](http://trk.secureandprosper._9Dig)**
---
[Say NO to the State Department targeting Christian](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
The U.S. State Department has just proposed new regulations that _will cut off grants and contracts_ to Christian—and all faith-based—relief organizations that require their employees to share their faith and their religious values. That means that relief organizations like **Samaritan's Purse** , a Christian ministry that has helped millions worldwide since its founding in 1970 ... Humanitarian organizations like **World Vision** , which has supported children in need and empowered millions of people out of poverty for more than 70 years ... And many thousands more **faith-based ministry, relief, and aid organizations** of all sizes that do immeasurable good work in God's name across the globe ...
**May be forced to SCALE DOWN—or SHUT DOWN—their operations, as they are unconstitutionally targeted for de-funding because of their Christian faith.** **[**Fellow American, Christian Legal Society is standing alongside religious groups and ministries to oppose this unconstitutional and immoral regulatory change from the U.S. State Department. Will you add your name to our open letter to join in this fight?**](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**
---
[Say NO to the State Department targeting Christians](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
Fellow American, no faith-based organization in America today should be forced to reject biblical principles ... and embrace the government's currently preferred social ideology ... or risk scaling down or shutting down their operations. Yet under the regulatory change that the U.S. State Department has proposed, funding and contracts could be denied to ANY group that has a statement of faith or policies that are true to biblical values but counter to today's predominantly "woke" social climate. That means organizations that protect life instead of promoting abortion, advocate for traditional marriage and family, or follow biblical teaching on biological sex rather than "gender ideology" are at risk of being targeted—and punished!—by the U.S. government. **[**Please stand with Christian Legal Society to express your strong opposition to the U.S. State Department targeting Christian and all faith-based relief organizations _on the basis of their religious beliefs!_ Add your name to our urgent open letter now.**](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**
---
[Say NO to the State Department targeting Christians](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society’s Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **This is one of the most urgent—and important—fights that we face for religious freedom this year,** and I am grateful for concerned Americans like you coming alongside us to defend Christian and all faith-based relief organizations in the battle today. Thank you for your prayers and for your consideration. David NammoExecutive Director & CEO Christian Legal Society

And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society’s Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. This is one of the most urgent—and important—fights that we face for religious freedom this year, and I am grateful for concerned Americans like you coming alongside us to defend Christian and all faith-based relief organizations in the battle today. Thank you for your prayers and for your consideration. David NammoExecutive Director & CEO Christian Legal Society Christian Legal Society P.O. name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Urgent Action Needed
body:
Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception.

|
---
| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it’s easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother’s voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31051%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TfsLSKrh6EpRQx%2bqeUtAMQ&sysid=1)[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31052%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lU7pFshWllVL7SPcLUfrUA&sysid=1)
_Marjorie Dannenfelser
President SBA Pro-Life America_ Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I’m not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we’re willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I’ve created a pro-life pledge and I’d love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31053%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mm6MHYOmwYb%2bgVqp1oYWRg&sysid=1) For Life,
Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

Friend
Last week President Biden submitted a proposed federal budget that spends trillions more than the nation can afford, hikes up taxes, and skimps on vital priorities like national security. The President calls this 'investing in the future,' but a debt-ridden, high-tax, insecure future isn't one any of us should be shooting for.
---
| [The Wall Street Journal](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016QvhR37y5p-ZWXTxTsZQu9cSI6j-61BSMM-91H_SkfQXWEQe6st1w4-w_hQdZfbu-zUrsleOz2sVBYFfmC0AN8QJ2pRsIihsVqP8PA_wlDhZNd2JBuCiKqWoYBz7_7eP_xtPJPV-wSzeNpmEdbQ196PjTXPoEnYVyrPEcVxLByFigruQ-QnVH81FYOuIaSNLR64HoM_y85WrdCTNtNpZRw==&c=mJ7AvXlXStQaIs2XAoXVIrQZjkwjI9A0kkRPoG3XAHR1dS4MowjQeg==&ch=KS3EchvDZ8Ho5ee6y8RI5Ju21QE1LrqiVTYnO1bJzPXRzHtu-ku4ww==) referred to the President's $7.3 trillion budget as a 'budget fantasy' that 'sets a record for unreality'--'the overall spending numbers fly in the face of fiscal reality.' The reality is that we already have a $34 trillion national debt and this budget heaps another $1.1 trillion spending increase on top of that, for an increase of 18% in government spending.
The proposed budget then tries to cover this crippling increase in spending by jacking up taxes. According to the Administration's own Treasury Department, the proposed budget would raise tax receipts by $4.951 trillion over 10 years, including more than $2.7 trillion in tax hikes on businesses and nearly $2 trillion on individuals.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016QvhR37y5p-ZWXTxTsZQu9cSI6j-61BSMM-91H_SkfQXWEQe6st1w8dDgh7EOGGuu7TzeW9lv093oezixIJJyD1r6IkM5mpZn1HkBFs4sjRKqdL5pJMjKAD9cSPUT9_pr66MlQZfOeooW6z8hPOcRkakxsvql1sGHJ293zEVy6V9NabPY9TpmQ==&c=mJ7AvXlXStQaIs2XAoXVIrQZjkwjI9A0kkRPoG3XAHR1dS4MowjQeg==&ch=KS3EchvDZ8Ho5ee6y8RI5Ju21QE1LrqiVTYnO1bJzPXRzHtu-ku4ww==)
---
|
To cap it all off, the proposed budget is awash with billions of spending on progressive pet projects while at the same time skimping on vital spending for our national defense. As the Journal noted, 'President Biden's budget proposal includes record spending for nearly every corner of government, but there's one big exception: national defense.'
The real-world impact of this means that while China is scaling up its navy to more than 350 ships, we will be outgunned and outmanned in the Pacific entering the most dangerous period ever of U.S.-China relations.

---
| | [HELP END THE FISCAL IRRESPONSIBILITY](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016QvhR37y5p-ZWXTxTsZQu9cSI6j-61BSMM-91H_SkfQXWEQe6st1w9e5eacCFN6wR6PkZJVEf4NwuhfKYc3fKnc7xr80ppIHEI7TdWGP-vG54UdhtgB6yyQlreZMISI1ygrouYZ6nRJiLNYgYZKg_-LFfdAksHaXCauHfnHU5rG1ZCOz8va5XUpzgH35iElEwGhIDNOA6N8YYELJkQyeKXUtmJPGNteMNqP8ZzO2cNrABxewXiou3Ce7d8xynRrexyUcHVOfNrvKRI1wX2zrPuJF1996K74AL--fae92T2k=&c=mJ7AvXlXStQaIs2XAoXVIrQZjkwjI9A0kkRPoG3XAHR1dS4MowjQeg==&ch=KS3EchvDZ8Ho5ee6y8RI5Ju21QE1LrqiVTYnO1bJzPXRzHtu-ku4ww==)
---
|

In a campaign ad last cycle, she implored: 'Democrats, stop the spending.'
Now is her chance to back up campaign rhetoric with actual action in Congress by opposing President Biden's irresponsible budget.

The President calls this 'investing in the future,' but a debt-ridden, high-tax, insecure future isn't one any of us should be shooting for. | == referred to the President's $7.3 trillion budget as a 'budget fantasy' that 'sets a record for unreality'--'the overall spending numbers fly in the face of fiscal reality.' The reality is that we already have a $34 trillion national debt and this budget heaps another $1.1 trillion spending increase on top of that, for an increase of 18% in government spending. The proposed budget then tries to cover this crippling increase in spending by jacking up taxes. According to the Administration's own Treasury Department, the proposed budget would raise tax receipts by $4.951 trillion over 10 years, including more than $2.7 trillion in tax hikes on businesses and nearly $2 trillion on individuals. | == | To cap it all off, the proposed budget is awash with billions of spending on progressive pet projects while at the same time skimping on vital spending for our national defense. As the Journal noted, 'President Biden's budget proposal includes record spending for nearly every corner of government, but there's one big exception: national defense.' The real-world impact of this means that while China is scaling up its navy to more than 350 ships, we will be outgunned and outmanned in the Pacific entering the most dangerous period ever of U.S.-China relations. | | == | This budget has our nation's priorities all wrong, and I call on our current representative in Washington, ==, to oppose this reckless plan. ## EPA Sets Electric Car Quota
The Biden administration released revised automobile emissions standards Wednesday, [requiring 56% of all new](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uxCAQBp_G7jjBAgYXFGmuu7QpLbws543wjwy6U94-cuqU3zfNaL4e0yNy4e35GVcKLe9TxMYvmrQAJcBMpk8hEwHpnoJySknwSg_9EhAVOp316NGPErPLdvZDllbSiKSp5wASjNSg5GgH424ayOs4O2vJRT_PnZGUuO3n7XvnrS2Uy8_-ovOG-9qXsLR21E5_dHDv4B6Pjd71Qtc4G2OhDu50REGFsJ2M4kXLdVdBK9fK-1ZF4ZVbFVh4jY3EzIk2QUOyXmkwMVsFo5HGpwwGhnG2CWTsz5CON5fCdXCdkc81cvmzav82-g0AAP__Qctn1w) vehicle sales to be electric by 2032. A previous proposal by the government for 67% of new cars to be electric by 2032 [was called "unworkable" ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwzAMBp_G3hSIpGQ5g4Yu2dK1o0FbdMxC_oElJOjbF-nc8ftuOdzXfbizZt0en7xKrPM-8FT1KQMZBINucG2KswgKtRIhAFjsgbp2iSkIwtS5HuA6X9NsvfjQOeuYqEtuajWiRWcJwV5958KFUHriMXgvgftxbJyVpHU_L9-7bnWROf_sTzkv0762OS61HqWhjwZvDd742ORV3ug9zqpTlgZvB5ci20NO85Tl_RUjq5ai-1ZM1lVrMXKwSYFH8EBI1FOaRdim5JMNAtbyOLVnTMdLc9bShcbZx8qa_0Tqv1l-AwAA__9gFmNS)by automakers. Overall, EV sales have slowed, and questions persist about the cost, range, and availability of public charging stations. The [White House effort](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwRsWHGDIwFCp8paqW0cLwyW-ChvLkFh5-6qdO__Lr-_rOl0DZdruH2FF325lCrHREyfFQXLQk-6SvyECqg69tFIKcFIN3eKdiNqaBDYZcGqQCaxywho3XNQgZtORBwFaKJDiYgZtewXoVJitMWiDm2emBSZq5ei_C21twVt-lScefSxrl_3S2l6ZemMwMhjDHDc8a38vv5nB-FkyNYqVwbjhyXEP_IkLxYy8trClcKTK46PxR-W4Uq1UtsqPsO4MxtrK8WJqpMTUuxQOrLPgusOn_aScqQ6WaXFfA-W_m_avzU8AAAD__4S6ZDE) to impose strict emission standards also demands 13% of new passenger cars to be plug-in hybrids. Critics believe the EPA's authority to dictate emissions limits could be challenged in the courts. [A 2022 ruling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwzAMBp_G3hSIpGQ5g4Yu2dK1o0FbdMxC_oElJOjbF-nc8ftuOdzXfbizZt0en7xKrPM-8FT1KQMZBINucG2KswgKtRIhAFjsgbp2iSkIwtS5HuA6X9NsvfjQOeuYqEtuajWiRWcJwV5958KFUHriMXgvgftxbJyVpHU_L9-7bnWROf_sTzkv0762OS61HqWhjwZvDd742ORV3ug9zqpTlgZvB5ci20NO85Tl_RUjq5ai-1ZM1lVrMXKwSYFH8EBI1FOaRdim5JMNAtbyOLVnTMdLc9bShcbZx8qa_0Tqv1l-AwAA__9gFmNS) by the Supreme Court limited the EPA's ability to regulate carbon dioxide emissions from power plants.
## Gallup: U.S. Getting Less Happy
Gallup's annual "World Happiness Report" once again names Finland the happiest nation, but the United States dropped out of the top 20 happiest countries for the first time. [Survey results are here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71yhCAUQOGngU4HLr8WFGnsNm1KB_SqZFAYYXezb59J6q1Pceb7uk03H1M8t09_oGtrnvzc4gMn0QHvQE6SLm5FBBQUHTecM7BcaLo7Zljg3IJCKzRKY8IAwqCWVttBBUajAwaSCeBsUFqaXgBa4YNRCo23IRDJcIktX_13jmfbcU2v_MCrn_NBk9tbK5WIDwIjgfHEZ-03n9K9_HUCY8kpERg1Bw6KwLj7UiLW1s35frbr1aG_2t77Wn7o5ZbyjCnFqg2RbDt8TP-b9hb9GwAA___61FcY) The reason for the U.S. decline is that people under the age of 30 feel worse about their lives, Gallup says. The U.S. actually ranks in the top 10 happiest countries for people older than 60. Overall, the survey also shows that "happiness inequality" is increasing between young and old people, with the younger generation declining sharply in life satisfaction.
## Planning Begins for 'Lunar Railroad'
A federal agency has selected aerospace giant Northrop Grumman [to plan a "lunar railroad"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnMRsWHGBgYOiSLV07WudwjqnAWJjG6ttX7dz5l37p-7jPd0w57c93LBT6Wmd89PSiWXGQHPSsWQwrEZBiFKSVUoCTamJbWIz3atVWaqe98lFZg84ATnYhN62epQACtFAghTeTtqMCcgoXawxZdMsyaEEx9drGz5r2vtGav-uL2vioheWw9X6cg3ob4DbA7bqu8TzwQb91gFvEdiDfa-tbqwd_tq9ScOel1p03TLlVjKyFeFwp53ROdtDiWTDlv3v_1_oTAAD__8b7VgY) to bring commercial development to the moon in the future. DARPA, the U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, is working with various companies to develop a[ ten-year Luna Architecture plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2v3CAQAH8N7rDM4q8rKNLQXdqU1hqW80YYLCBn5d8_3atfP9KM5s9zeyJHTq_feJJpIW_oGr9p0xKUhHEbO28CEZDuyKhFqQFWpefuMAFX_4DgFU7LHpSbvfN7mGmcg171Qh0bGGAcNKjhMc3j0mugVeO-TBMtuO67GAfy3HLp_2ZO7aAQ_-c3ld7ls4vmaO2qQv8SYAXY-757T4FSpUR3_TAC7I6tRQpM0ctG7hBg64WOBNiPXIAdtACrHgJsyqUdJV_SY7lQUnpz5ZzkmXOSBTmWjF6GXGT8l7DImF9cG7sqwHbF-OvmGLnOixiH14kcvzvbj9e-AgAA__904W_-) and chose Northrop Grumman to produce concepts for a freight railroad on the moon. The plan will include the resources needed, an outline of costs and risks, and concepts for building and operating a track-based system using robotics. The final report will be shared at a consortium meeting in June.

| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0c59466dfe1a4dfca86abd11018e61dc&_e=3h9WxDJY62EFaQ1p1jgPHcSdaPZ9NOKcSZlhYeK8L74ilP8xfPeG2-8nYikiEh9rGis8Rn-nQ4UWnohGuEGPAncHspnsvvz69qYnZ5UCKi-o4NmL2oBYIciVQ-mmzj4i0l33btYOMEmhZiFSWzNXZft09DKaUijUDu3oBapkgNrxHXsQ_CQgFcWPQi_BSFnWUEr_7BwaHbHYA-YDBXpd0v8K6_PY2O1kO8pNGt1lq0CiQB7iUZ3EKb_C6Fg8fNuZvf8_jLND3FSWeuBIKq1CWi73GNAshGM_91jhqewfnzEv784XVWnrlNCYyb9HF3ZtGCWouu-zKhwZao9HR2tMIL7_GXDo1iQS2hawZca8KpJfHgc5NoQAaNO7JoyyKaF-xTNv2m4dsSOACwaZkHqr2sWXSRySphwVf4OjWTHvtIY%3D)
_Marjorie Dannenfelser
President SBA Pro-Life America_ Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. clean_body: Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. | | | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive. Marjorie Dannenfelser President SBA Pro-Life America Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. name: Costello for U.S. Senate
subject: Costello for Senate March 2024 Update
body:
Dear Friend,

__
____
Having collected well over 3,000 voter signatures and having submitted the maximum admissible, 2,500, to Maine’s Secretary of State, David is the only Democrat to have qualified for Maine’s Democratic primary election in June. This means that he is extremely well positioned, if not guaranteed, to be the Democratic Party’s U.S. Senate nominee in this November’s general election.____
____
While the U.S. Senate race in Maine has thus far garnered little attention, we continue to engage voters and activists via email, phone calls, in-person and Zoom meetings, DEM Party events, and social media. With the field set with David, Senator King, and the qualified GOP candidate,[Demi Kousounas](https://mainebeacon.com/kings-republican-challenger-has-a-history-of-pushing-election-covid-conspiracies/), we are focused on promoting David as the most energetic, broadly experienced, and genuine change candidate in the race.____
____
So, as we ramp up our campaign efforts please let us know of events or voter contact opportunities in your area and anything else that you might be willing to help with, by emailing us at:[ campaign@costelloforsenate.com](mailto:campaign@costelloforsenate.com).____
____
Additionally, please consider following us on Instagram and “X” (formerly Twitter) and sharing and reposting any posts that you find compelling.____
____
Instagram:[ https://www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate/](https://www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate/)____
Twitter:[ https://www.twitter.com/costello4senate/ ](https://www.twitter.com/costello4senate/) ____
****
Also, if you are able, please consider a campaign donation. A contribution, no matter the amount, will help in ensuring that our message of reform, REAL change, and progress is heard.____
[ DONATE HERE >>](https://secure.actblue.com/entity/fundraisers/145994)____
____
P. S. The draft excerpt to Maine Democrats below should give you a sense of some of the messaging that we are working to convey:____
____
“As many of you already know, I have chosen to run for the U.S. Senate because I am very concerned about the health of our democracy and the performance of our government.____
____
Republican-imposed gridlock and dysfunction in Washington abounds and to fix it we need to do more than simply change whom we elect every two to six years. We need to substantially reform our governing practices and institutions, and eliminate the excessive and corrupting influence that money, wealth, and disinformation have over our politics and government.____
____
While it 's evident that achieving many of the reforms ([www.costelloforsenate.com](http://www.costelloforsenate.com/)) that I am promoting won’t be easy. None are genuinely radical and most have the support of nearly all our nation’s top political scientists and economists. Moreover, the fact that a record number of Americans are crying out for meaningful political change increases the chances that we could enact some of the suggested reforms if sufficient attention, reason, and effort are applied. ____
____
What clearly isn’t working in Washington, is doing more of the same. Fighting over a half-dozen or slightly more U.S. House or Senate seats, when substantive systems change, is what is really needed. ____
Having grown up in a working-class family in Old Town and having worked for more than 25 years in senior-level local, state, and federal government positions, including in Maine and abroad, I believe that I have the broadest and most fitting experience of all the candidates competing to represent Maine in the U.S. Senate.____
____
I do not believe Maine’s GOP candidate for the U.S. Senate, given her lack of governing experience and MAGA conspiracies dissemination, is a serious candidate. Concerning Senator King, while I appreciate service, I believe he’s been too reticent to pursue the kind of reforms and policies needed to fix what ails Washington and he’s unlikely to alter his overly cautious approach during what is likely to be his last term.____
Moreover, excepting Senator Bernie Sanders, I believe that independent candidates and candidacies have on balance undermined the Democratic Party’s efforts to grow and succeed. In large part, because they feed into and off the false narrative that both major political parties are responsible for the dysfunction in Washington.____
____
While we Democrats bear some responsibility for Washington’s failures, it’s nothing in comparison to that of the Republican Party. Which for over thirty years, has purposefully chosen to impose gerrymanders, government shutdowns, national debt default threats, and other means to prevent the enactment of sound, broadly popular government policies and reforms. And it’s only getting worse!” ____

Thank you and best regards,

Grace

I earned my degree from Harvard Law and left the high-paying world of commercial litigation to protect Americans from their own government. Through NCLU, I have represented over 30 Americans who were charged with crimes for being present in Washington, DC, on January 6th, 2021.

My trial schedule is packed, and we are running drastically low on funds to support these Patriots, who face an army of lawyers working for Biden's Department of Justice.

Any assistance you can provide will be greatly appreciated and put to immediate use, **[so please watch their stories and contribute any amount you can afford.](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2F2bRpjAXfpySkoAhRN0Jn5Q%2F6xVV51OZNLjgWpqX0nvgnA/6/0100018e60d700ec-f5481c66-90c0-4413-abca-3afe10ea339a-000000/yrJpjJZ46Z-75TYW0McyglM92bw=366)**

John M. Pierce

We have good news, Friend Unknown.
New legislation from Pennsylvania House Speaker Joanna McClinton (D-Philadelphia) will make it more convenient for hardworking Pennsylvania voters to fit casting a ballot into their busy schedules.

The proposed bill would change state voting rules allowing registered Pennsylvania voters to vote early in person during the two weeks leading up to Election Day. The legislation would also allow same-day voter registration at polling locations on Election Day.
Allowing voters to register and cast a ballot on Election Day will make voting more accessible AND improve election security.
We support Speaker McClinton’s Voting Access Legislation and so should you, your state rep, and state senator. Read the full memo [here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=436c6a055c&e=95417d7e87).
|
---
# NPP In The News
**Democrats running for auditor general shine light on their differences
** The affiliated organization New PA Project Education Fund was recently featured in the news. Democratic auditor general candidates Mark Pinsley and State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta participated in a forum on Zoom on Monday hosted by New PA Project Education Fund, a non-partisan organization dedicated to advocating for underrepresented and underserved communities. Read the full article in [Penn Live](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=af904f0dd8&e=95417d7e87).

# News You Can Use
**McClinton unveils legislation to add early voting and same-day registration in Pennsylvania**
Pennsylvania House Speaker Joanna McClinton (D-Philadelphia) on Tuesday outlined her proposed legislation that would change state voting rules to allow same-day voting and early voting, to boost participation and accessibility, [Penn Capital Star reports.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=0e7b8fbf59&e=95417d7e87)
**Tens of thousands of Pennsylvanians don’t realize they’re eligible to vote, yet their voices can swing an election**
Many people who are incarcerated or have been in the past are eligible to vote but don't realize it. And in a swing state such as ours, every vote matters, [The Philadelphia Inquirer](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=2f58f79342&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**With party nominations clinched, Pennsylvania could decide who wins the presidency in 2024** With last Tuesday's primary victories, both President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump have clinched their party nominations for this fall, [CBS News reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=94b9c145f0&e=95417d7e87).
**Election deniers make up one-third of the Pennsylvania legislature, new report shows**
A recent report published by States United Action found that Pennsylvania has the highest number of election deniers serving in office in the seven states they studied, [Keystone Newsroom reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=343403a9d0&e=95417d7e87).
**Pa. nonpartisan group seeks volunteers to serve as poll monitors in 2024**
A nonpartisan government watchdog group is recruiting volunteers to be trained for a 2024 Election Protection poll monitoring program, [Penn Live reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=a125eb0286&e=95417d7e87).

body:
It took ten years, but last week we settled our 2014 Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. State Department that sought then-Secretary of State Hillary Clinton’s emails regarding the Benghazi attack.

| | |

Dear Fellow American,

The news in the email below is so important that I want to be sure you have a chance to read it...

..because it says so much about the impact of Judicial Watch's work, _and_ about how our system of laws still works to achieve transparency and accountability.

Our lawsuits can take years to work through government bureaucracies and the courts, but _they get results_...and that's why [I hope you can help with a special contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67538&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2).

Thank you for all you do to help us fight for the rule of law!

Thank you,

Tom Fitton

* * *

**From:** Tom Fitton
**Date:** Thur, March 14, 2024 at 9:14 AM
**Subject:** This Is Why We Never Give Up!
**To:** dpwillis67@gmail.com
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

**Thank you!**
It took ten years, but last week we settled our 2014 Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. State Department that sought then-Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's emails regarding the Benghazi attack.
This is the lawsuit that forced the Obama administration to admit to Hillary Clinton's hidden classified and other government emails in 2015... _and that broke open the dam of information about her emails that led directly to her defeat in 2016_!
The American people owe Judicial Watch an enormous debt of thanks...and [I ask for your support today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67538&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) so we can keep doing the long, hard, and expensive work of breaking through government secrecy and demanding accountability from the corupt and powerful!

---

It is no small matter to _pursue a lawsuit for ten years against the deep pockets of the federal government_ , contributions from patriotic Americans make that possible.

Today, we are pursuing dozens of lawsuits against the federal government to get to the truth about Biden family corruption, over Deep State efforts to take down Donald Trump, plus dozens of lawsuits to force accountability about how our tax dollars are being spent...and of course we're fighting in state courts to keep our elections honest.

Your [contribution now will help us](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67538&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) make sure we can keep digging in _for as long as it takes_ and keep fighting for you, for the rule of law and for the American people&squo;s "right to know!"

The Republican Study Committee’s new budget is absolutely shameful, and a major threat to public safety
#

We have bad news:
The Republican Study Committee—a caucus of the US House of Representatives’ most right-wing members—just released a budget proposal that would **destroy** the progress we’ve made in our gun safety movement with the historic _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ (BSCA).
[**Will you help us fight back against extreme House Republicans and their dangerous budget proposal by rushing in a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240321-1-30&t=1&akid=7802%2E3935704%2ErQHIzT)
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240321-1-30&t=2&akid=7802%2E3935704%2ErQHIzT)**
The committee’s budget proposal would require the ATF to “destroy all firearm transaction records on file” — making it impossible for ATF to trace crime guns.
The new budget would eliminate the BSCA’s funding for states to pass and implement extreme risk protection order or “red flag” laws. These laws help keep guns out of the wrong hands by allowing a court to temporarily remove firearms from a person who poses a risk of violence to others or themselves.
The Republican Study Committee’s new budget is absolutely shameful, and a major threat to public safety. This extreme faction of the Republican Party is masquerading under the false pretense that passing any sort of gun safety measures infringes on Second Amendment rights.
But we know this isn’t true. And we know that gun safety laws save lives.
[**We must do whatever it takes to regain control of the US House and prevent two more years of extremist leadership. Please, make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to support us in these crucial efforts.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240321-1-30&t=3&akid=7802%2E3935704%2ErQHIzT)

School choice refers to the various options and alternatives available to parents when choosing an educational path for their children. These options can include traditional public schools, public charter schools, private schools, homeschooling, and online learning. There are several potential benefits associated with school choice:
1. Customization: School choice allows parents to select the best educational environment for their child's unique needs, interests, and learning styles. This can lead to a more personalized and effective learning experience.
2. Competition: The introduction of school choice creates a competitive environment among schools, which can lead to improvements in the quality of education. Schools are incentivized to improve their offerings and performance in order to attract and retain students.
3. Innovation: School choice encourages the development of new educational models and approaches, as schools strive to differentiate themselves and meet the diverse needs of students.
4. Accountability: School choice can increase accountability in the education system, as schools must perform well in order to maintain enrollment and funding. This can lead to better educational outcomes for students.
5. Empowerment: School choice empowers parents to take an active role in their children's education, allowing them to make informed decisions about the best educational path for their child.

Overall, school choice can lead to a more diverse, innovative, and effective educational system that better meets the needs of individual students and families.

name: Wes Moore
subject: Black Excellence
body:
Friend,

Over the last two decades, racial inequality has cost the American economy $16 trillion . It’ll cost another $1 trillion in the next 10 years. We need to address this immediately, and it’ll take us working together to build an ownership society.

I am working to address racial inequality by elevating Black excellence and creating a society where all can thrive. We're taking control of our destiny and stopping people from saying no to us.

I know what it feels like to be told you can’t do something — it’s happened all my life. But Black excellence means that we don't have to compromise who we are in every space that we're in. Black excellence means being excellent everywhere you are.

We don’t have to live in boundaries, we don’t have to fit into predetermined boxes. It means that we can excel in academics, politics, entrepreneurship, athletics, community advocacy — anything we put our minds to.
We can be elected officials, and work in public service to serve the people. When I ran for office, I ran on fighting for solutions for the issues affecting Black Marylanders. As the first Black Governor of Maryland, I take this responsibility seriously.

From where we live, where we work, what type of healthcare we receive, to what type of positions people think we can hold, I am keeping good on my promise to lift up Black families in Maryland. We have a unique opportunity to be bold about the systemic and generational challenges that have held families back for decades.

I am working to support Black business owners in our state, and supporting students to learn about service by joining our service year program — the first of its kind. I am focusing on increasing homeownership and economic opportunities. Black excellence means we all have a fair shot at accomplishing all of our dreams, and I’m working to ensure we all have that opportunity.

There is so much more work to do, and I’m looking forward to the fight ahead to bring real solutions for all of us.

Elevate,

Wes

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=233b35c768134661ade85babe900ef9d&_e=XcCFEEd0s-nRHAiZh80xKoN_pgZTXZ-lXdRNur0M5kvcRswzz1tmQZdbM3ElVv-6KL5OjIQ5ev2ekKxORz45DDfUY3a7qw6Pi1l5lCkC_rCJjS6agBqx7ozdKQCKPUaFZocAqMYtkfcpdVmZZSNhFvJtmziHNaOAcLz5nhWaLsu1th0i_zYfACdEYmkx23DmxC1wDpYspT0ryx6CUDHGgdiV5JQH6YnzTn0f4FUBs1OJOxc1RvjoZ8cN7jRqGaJbTB6_CD3LpMYC6ND3kw6HM_ilOGixVMxsZNUi2RkolKVb3cH4EWXwKEnLooxvc-c17NqB2S9EeKPGEu5HNRvJMza79HFsyh30ZvqPud_fiodiKyTRyfyqh-DcAOTs-Pah9bo5rAaNM7em5UwzGLSjaLwe5wPOF56jcsfubVCeXH8%3D)
Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=233b35c768134661ade85babe900ef9d&_e=XcCFEEd0s-nRHAiZh80xKoN_pgZTXZ-lXdRNur0M5kvcRswzz1tmQZdbM3ElVv-6KL5OjIQ5ev2ekKxORz45DDfUY3a7qw6Pi1l5lCkC_rCJjS6agBqx7ozdKQCKPUaFZocAqMYtkfcpdVmZZSNhFvJtmziHNaOAcLz5nhWaLsu1th0i_zYfACdEYmkx23DmxC1wDpYspT0ryx6CUDHGgdiV5JQH6YnzTn0f4FUBs1OJOxc1RvjoZ8cN7jRqGaJbTB6_CD3LpMYC6ND3kw6HM0q5slUu1wu18YTHkkaMjICdDsGBkJ4HifZNQQu1knm9LRlLoxsPJv4r2ffqWRrCclw3wQxRXIGv_jq1E8VQNT7K5LUMgxJxEh6xWtxfujg8bGjct0bpSJZuxnofEa7YXr5u0PvQWZwGKU2D0txqN-I%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=233b35c768134661ade85babe900ef9d&_e=XcCFEEd0s-nRHAiZh80xKoN_pgZTXZ-lXdRNur0M5kvcRswzz1tmQZdbM3ElVv-6KL5OjIQ5ev2ekKxORz45DDfUY3a7qw6Pi1l5lCkC_rCJjS6agBqx7ozdKQCKPUaFZocAqMYtkfcpdVmZZSNhFvJtmziHNaOAcLz5nhWaLsu1th0i_zYfACdEYmkx23DmxC1wDpYspT0ryx6CUDHGgdiV5JQH6YnzTn0f4FUBs1OJOxc1RvjoZ8cN7jRqGaJbTB6_CD3LpMYC6ND3kw6HMyfTUzwQtSm3kfxj2XE664zghhuzUWZCyG56gYmfCJu7shS1XtTbjTFT0uo8E2VtcD8vfen4OLLgMVN65dcgkLWccoC_ZBB4UzkkGiztRjQ11EnKbNS6ML9EcVWZIIvb5jwIXuOKCa7RKdH62LLGp0o%3D)**

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

body:
As a candidate in 2022, Hillary Scholten sold herself to West Michigan voters as some kind of mainstream moderate, but her voting record shows nothing more than party-line orthodoxy.
| | |
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JOMeUFG4XFbUN11OtrDF8R8io2eOmpswtINgXc4r2PsC0F4H-Iag6MeiX_H_8NZ_lrmBmv0tj1VabzAppfVlKwwZYqlnO37vCfMib1kMeArw1YQK8gujJs7ko52QJ-9QekO7tCoUXpbKe2iKYxVRmwQZQbgVX34O&c=t49w8F52kDkoNlKtbh9fe-AEOrUuCic64-xRaniRqPAeOnCki26l1g==&ch=0FhEseRoVH6mDo5Xro208mw5aE2OHtmxyA4wuzeYy5NHijy3suRqTQ==)
---
|
Friend
To most people, the term 'bipartisan' means a style of constructive engagement with the other political party and a genuine interest in working cooperatively. But politicians like Hillary Scholten use this term to camouflage their real ideology.
---
| As a candidate in 2022, Hillary Scholten sold herself to West Michigan voters as some kind of mainstream moderate, but those who have closely watched her in Washington see nothing more than party-line orthodoxy in her votes.
The independent non-profit Common Ground Committee rates all House and Senate members on bipartisanship. Despite all of Rep. Scholten's political posturing, she falls in the 'below average' category according to their review, with a score of just 17 out of 100.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JOMeUFG4XFbUN11OtrDF8R8io2eOmpswtINgXc4r2PsC0F4H-Iag6Jw6w1McsOfdzJ8STqlXCY_Nb6gOiC_R-cvH94mYGoXVnMJmElz4ZbE4cjkybIyXkR0vLBXdLwDCl6FDOxY0NhDFFqxcKtJCqh2swsPL19qtNaKc97RqroqHYscvZypHNA==&c=t49w8F52kDkoNlKtbh9fe-AEOrUuCic64-xRaniRqPAeOnCki26l1g==&ch=0FhEseRoVH6mDo5Xro208mw5aE2OHtmxyA4wuzeYy5NHijy3suRqTQ==)
---
| To get a sense for how out of step Hillary is with both the Third Congressional District and Michigan generally, her bipartisan score was abysmal compared to her Michigan delegation colleagues. Out of 13 members, Rep. Scholten ranks 10th in her willingness to work across the aisle.
The numbers don't lie. After promising to be one of the most bipartisan members in Congress, Scholten got to Congress and has voted party-line 96% of the time.
---
| | [HELP END HILLARY SCHOLTEN'S PARTISAN AGENDA](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JOMeUFG4XFbUN11OtrDF8R8io2eOmpswtINgXc4r2PsC0F4H-Iag6KAVy9Ep2lHteiPJT384pUVeE3jnUTQz2HIM5SoYmH-3zhYBLQFS14q5osceq3s-OildIm0JSVW3sl3mJ_WnXqOCUbwssXb4IqjH5M1NK3_RltKysPGvDLMfH52MgYODTk1oAySwAytifGbBr7oOwj0AINrFYAmFEy1K4ZCPSTr_g2WSy1qFLSou7TkRzxoViHhIJXPP7Bvk0zLEaPpa9ScOy7AxPGH5Hre57l7i1T6Z43eqtZiFVfOoANUj8FJ5_UIrBeQb1UnMErUXR3ELINnrFhdcl0ds1w==&c=t49w8F52kDkoNlKtbh9fe-AEOrUuCic64-xRaniRqPAeOnCki26l1g==&ch=0FhEseRoVH6mDo5Xro208mw5aE2OHtmxyA4wuzeYy5NHijy3suRqTQ==)
---
|
On top of that, Big Labor's scorecard on Hillary shows she's in lockstep with 90% of their agenda, while a conservative Washington policy group gives her a '0' score. So much for bipartisan voting behavior.
As a [candidate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JOMeUFG4XFbUN11OtrDF8R8io2eOmpswtINgXc4r2PsC0F4H-Iag6MeiX_H_8NZ_eVjjo_oiBMO1a9DSmDo1UMhOmOHONl2UQS45bW2asWvVxefq5b1mxD15I-xtTCWIA82BZsmtv7-g9ybXsCsBp-3qoouB9Tce&c=t49w8F52kDkoNlKtbh9fe-AEOrUuCic64-xRaniRqPAeOnCki26l1g==&ch=0FhEseRoVH6mDo5Xro208mw5aE2OHtmxyA4wuzeYy5NHijy3suRqTQ==) I hope this November election is an honest discussion of who is best able to represent the interests and values of West Michigan. Toward that end, I will continue to put forward specifics on issues of real concern to this district and, at the same time, I hope Hillary will discard the false advertising and level with voters.
As always, never hesitate to [reach out](mailto:josh@paulhudsonforcongress.com).
Humbly, Paul

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In a surprising move, U.S. Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer denounced
right-wing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and called for an
election in Israel in light of the humanitarian crisis worsening in Gaza —
and AIPAC didn’t like it.

The GOP megadonor-funded lobby group condemned Schumer’s statement and
ironically said, “Israel is an independent democracy that decides for
itself when elections are held and chooses its own leaders.”

That’s interesting, because as we speak, AIPAC is spending more than $100
million from mostly Republican donors to influence democratic primaries,
specifically attacking Black and brown incumbents like Rep. Jamaal Bowman
with unprecedented spending.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240321-jb.4KPoLo&refcode=em20240321-33920&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=33920%2E1203867%2E62Xz5t ]Can you chip in $5 between Justice Democrats and
Jamaal’s campaign now to help us fend off attacks and defend his seat in
this June’s primary?

George Latimer — AIPAC’s hand-picked, moderate candidate challenging
Jamaal for his seat in NY-16 — has refused to comment on Schumer’s
statement, but we know he spoke on a panel at AIPAC’s conference last week
and has made racist, Islamophobic claims about Jamaal and others who
support a ceasefire. And it’s no wonder why: Latimer has received $600,000
from AIPAC.

Jamaal had this to say about it, and he’s right:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240321-jb.4KPoLo&refcode=em20240321-33920&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=33920%2E1203867%2E62Xz5t ]Tweet from Rep. Jamaal Bowman: Aligning with Netanyahu and GOP mega
donors instead of the US Senate Majority Leader from New York shows a deep
moral failure. This isn’t hard! The civilian death toll is catastrophic.
Children are starving. We must listen to constituents. Not a closed-door
room of GOP donors.

We cannot let a fake Democrat in the pocket of AIPAC replace a progressive
champion like Jamaal in Congress. We’re fighting to stop this lobby
group’s dark money influence in our elections and re-elect Jamaal (and the
rest of the Squad) this year, but we can’t do it alone.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240321-jb.4KPoLo&refcode=em20240321-33920&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=33920%2E1203867%2E62Xz5t ]Please, help Justice Democrats and Jamaal go up against AIPAC’s war
chest by splitting a grassroots donation today →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240321-jb.4KPoLo&refcode=em20240321-33920&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=33920%2E1203867%2E62Xz5t ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats
