body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1244%2E135344%2EVtxNa6)
Friends -
It's almost the end of March, and that means if you're anything like me you're seeing non-stop requests for money from political campaigns and organizations. And as you have likely seen, there are some striking similarities in these emails and the tactics they use:
There's the 3x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-1-700&t=2&akid=1244%2E135344%2EVtxNa6)
The 5x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-1-700&t=3&akid=1244%2E135344%2EVtxNa6)
And even the 10x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-1-700&t=4&akid=1244%2E135344%2EVtxNa6)
Here's the thing: none of that is real. No one is matching donations. They are trying to trick people into donating. It's cynical, and it's something we're never going to do here.
But we do have very real March fundraising goals. And right now, we are very much behind where we need to be with time running out.
Almost all of the donations our campaign receives comes from people giving smaller donations — often in response to emails like this one. But that means we have to ask.
And while I don't expect you to donate to every email we send, I hope that you will contribute to this one. It's an important time for our campaign, as we approach our first FEC fundraising deadline of the election year.
[**With all that in mind, can you please use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today? There's no matching donation, no super-donor ready to 10x your contribution—but it will help ensure we win this Senate race in Michigan and probably the presidential campaign in the state, as well.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-1-700&t=5&akid=1244%2E135344%2EVtxNa6)

name: John Deaton
subject: FW: The next big FEC deadline
body:
| | | |
---
Hi Peter,
Did you see Elizabeth Warren's latest email? Check it out below.
Her message is simple: send me back to Washington D.C. to raise taxes, increase spending, and rely on big government to over-regulate small businesses.
Warren has no problem pointing the finger at others and being a divisive person for her own political gain.
This is her playbook.
---
| [DONATE](https://scqeb6gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kmsXxyn4sM_NCOvX5_SNmZ8tkyEzPIl2tJ9DGUwoylgkVcmZmzuxP1qRvH0QveY9FuheePffSuUDIEydNFPQRHrEdsqemnuP9Wn07316-uLHbWIwdQMQQ3sX41C3dLnLGjIW8mxDLdoJBqcXqrEw9O91i0H1738T-egCoS5O6c2nxYTEHAkgGcTLcb5lfQ5w0SokPsiRYpOhtGrv5MZFI2XCH1uT9CaKrOmRUuxZbA0Wzh2-g0P99Odp8nncz0KX&c=z9J8T6zhSpSp5j7SgQWnf0AevaecINfl1tXzFo8TRIVogweC3IdjIw==&ch=EAPRkt8-4YbtLGbwYx0_yRieromTXIbnAx9BVpPpJA1zsuueSnGG_g==)
---
I'm running for Senate because, like you, I know more government isn't the solution. I'm concerned about the direction our country is headed. We need people in Washington who are willing to talk to each other, not political partisans like Warren, who only talk to their side.
We can unseat Warren and bring this seat back to the people. Our first big fundraising deadline is March 31st; please consider supporting this cause and chipping in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can do to ensure we have the resources necessary to take on Elizabeth Warren.
Thank you,
John
---
| [DONATE](https://scqeb6gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kmsXxyn4sM_NCOvX5_SNmZ8tkyEzPIl2tJ9DGUwoylgkVcmZmzuxP1qRvH0QveY9FuheePffSuUDIEydNFPQRHrEdsqemnuP9Wn07316-uLHbWIwdQMQQ3sX41C3dLnLGjIW8mxDLdoJBqcXqrEw9O91i0H1738T-egCoS5O6c2nxYTEHAkgGcTLcb5lfQ5w0SokPsiRYpOhtGrv5MZFI2XCH1uT9CaKrOmRUuxZbA0Wzh2-g0P99Odp8nncz0KX&c=z9J8T6zhSpSp5j7SgQWnf0AevaecINfl1tXzFo8TRIVogweC3IdjIw==&ch=EAPRkt8-4YbtLGbwYx0_yRieromTXIbnAx9BVpPpJA1zsuueSnGG_g==)
---
No Fear, Never Give Up,
---
---
John Deaton Candidate for US Senate
---

\---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Elizabeth Warren Date: March 19, 2024 at 7:04:27 PM EDT Subject: The next big FEC deadline Reply-To: info@elizabethwarren.com
>
>
> I'm running for re-election this year to keep fighting for Massachusetts families, help preserve our Democratic majority in the U.S. Senate, and make real change. Like ensuring universal child care. Guaranteeing the right to an abortion nationwide. Passing a wealth tax to fund opportunities for all of our kids.
> But the GOP and special interests will fuel my opponents' campaigns because they want to knock me and this team out of the game. And if Republicans take power, they'll work to prioritize giant corporations over working people. Ban abortion nationwide. Keep the rich from paying what they owe.
> This election is about two fundamentally different visions for our future. Two fundamentally different understandings of who our government should work for.
> I'm in this fight to protect our freedoms, defend our democracy, and put Washington on the side of families -- but to win, we've got to keep growing our grassroots campaign.
> [Before our next big FEC fundraising deadline on March 31, can you make a donation of $28 or any amount? Your support will help strengthen our re-election campaign, show how strong this team is, and enact policies that families will feel in their daily lives.](https://scqeb6gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kmsXxyn4sM_NCOvX5_SNmZ8tkyEzPIl2tJ9DGUwoylgkVcmZmzuxP1qRvH0QveY9fcFWtJX3iXPGEkeKmeu7V13FYOe027aiRyF4iBzR4i79LVpuemroKYgcFcS6ZsZR3KulA7_ggMGf-rm6LSRplgt03yymx4Hf2yIfS62ztSB5-9HPIKaMpOzeaeRYdHUEbZjLx0LQ1zf17fQOW2CZzMC61QSI2Q9h-f4o00S7tjMsQ0-Knv6BaQ==&c=z9J8T6zhSpSp5j7SgQWnf0AevaecINfl1tXzFo8TRIVogweC3IdjIw==&ch=EAPRkt8-4YbtLGbwYx0_yRieromTXIbnAx9BVpPpJA1zsuueSnGG_g==)
>
>
> For this election and beyond, I know that there's only one way to defeat entrenched special interests and put power in the hands of working people.
> It's the same way we overcame the big banks to launch the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. The same way we beat big manufacturers to lower the cost of hearing aids. The same way we defied high-priced lobbyists to pass my minimum tax on massive corporate profits.
> It comes down to this: staying in the fight by growing our grassroots movement -- together. We raise our voices to call out what's broken, we lay out our plans to fix it, and we fight side by side to make change.
> [Grassroots donors make our movement possible, so I have to ask: if it makes sense for you right now, will you pitch in any amount to our re-election campaign before the March 31 FEC deadline? After then, we'll report our fundraising numbers for the past three months, and we need to show as much strength as possible to show our opponents that our big ideas have broad support.](https://scqeb6gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kmsXxyn4sM_NCOvX5_SNmZ8tkyEzPIl2tJ9DGUwoylgkVcmZmzuxP1qRvH0QveY9CKsOtml26Me2tlfOBj69wTgodgDXyplRXiQEHFFCioEDFqoaTRpjcCzrWLMfZY4Pks00mdGubU8lxSkoHgheqnyQsHMbvGUkJfgd0urpOYAr3C9kYtT0brsZjJRSeXj7f2EiGLTQRso0Pnkvf27SahK7kZ6-Rsbn&c=z9J8T6zhSpSp5j7SgQWnf0AevaecINfl1tXzFo8TRIVogweC3IdjIw==&ch=EAPRkt8-4YbtLGbwYx0_yRieromTXIbnAx9BVpPpJA1zsuueSnGG_g==)
> Thanks for being a part of this,
> Elizabeth
>
>

Friend,

This is the most important email you will receive all year. Keep reading. This is proof the Deep State exists.

I was getting anxious, so recently, I released an entire recording of the time a Deep State agent tried to bribe me and get me to step away from politics. I wanted you to know that I'm not sitting cozy in a comfy job because I f****** care about this country so much.

Considering everything that's happened means we must tell the country our story, and we need to keep fighting no matter what. We've come too far to give up now.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

I’ve never forgotten the feeling of being 17, so lost and confused but also filled with so much ambition to make a life for myself. I am taking the same ambition to Congress, to fight for you. Thanks for your support, Nancy Mace P.S. I know money is tight, but truly one dollar can make a difference in a campaign like mine because these races come down to the last minute and the last dollar. So, if you only have a dollar to spare, please know how thankful I am for your support, and I hope to continue to make you proud in Congress. | | About Nancy Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher. She is a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! In 2020, she took SC-01 back from the Democrats and now, is fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red. go.txting.io/mEWDMy | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Nancy Mace for Congress Nancy Mace for Congress | 295 Seven Farms Drive, Suite C-186, Charleston, SC 29492

name: Matt Dolan
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DOLAN FOR OHIO
body:
|
---
Dear: Peter

Jessica and I wanted to send along a personal note of thanks to our volunteers, supporters, and donors. We have been humbled beyond words by the hard work of our team and all who generously gave their time, resources, and prayers to this effort. As disappointing as the results of the March 19 primary are for me, I feel so honored and blessed to count you as a friend and supporter. I am sorry all your hard work did not end up in victory. Every vote we received was the result of your hard work. Over the past fourteen months, I had the opportunity to visit with Ohioans in every region of our great state. You opened up your homes, businesses and hearts. You took a chance on a kid from Cleveland who spent much of the race behind, and never lost faith in our effort. We embraced truth and a positive conservative agenda that will build a stronger, freer nation. I am proud to have joined you in a campaign which focused on Ohio and America. The way to a better Ohio and America is to improve the opportunities, safety and quality of life of every Ohioan and American citizen. You understood this with me. I will continue to focus on Ohio in the remaining months I have in the Ohio Senate.

Ohio Republicans have spoken and now it's time to look forward, united in our conservative convictions to make Ohio and America a better place to live, work, and raise a family.

From Day 1, I promised that I would make this race about Ohio, because Ohio matters! I did so because I believed - and I continue to believe - that what you fight for is equally as important as how you fight for it. We should expect that from our public leaders today. It's not only how we make our country stronger, but it's also how we beat back divisiveness that stands in the way of progress.

It has been an honor to lead this charge and to stand with pride for our state. The primary campaign is over, but the cause of freedom endures. I don't know if there is another political chapter for me beyond this year. I hope you will see me as a friend and supporter of you in any way I can be helpful.

Thank you for your votes and trust in my candidacy.

Matt

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Do this one thing to stand for life today
body:
Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? |
---
| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=ac73174cb5a444c9b841b4966f625d05&_t=-ONE3DZimhr3i-2SvYzNPDRPaDgIafZEqUjXffxF3TAzMLYXh8YJC2ZyNMLcXROGFSVeE_QD_AfP8LjXxzsBQfEl6fyipfnmc2SMCgtZPAI%3D)_
---
From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ac73174cb5a444c9b841b4966f625d05&_e=J4rcGxegXNB6VAMhA19djRQGb6nVhf8mRvGjgmXtyp5agMKzS2i3HePUfFoJ8vwNxOCWThUhEnhas7y-1Mm7gA7bVsRstPYlpSInlu0LQpltwbQfiq-fYup1m_Wc499WmYVR5i-P29RD4ZfBpgyifzniOpO3pfewCFi29gfp1l-Nn4zajeSniPPsXGWK2z9_gXpXmLaIVCAld8YMWDRoVedJ-GVSjfUvh9mM3lA01x8Gw_46kUbUsHnpZXGmPZSpOcNQemRKWmLgZHQQMN0LwqUDXMYkPgGmDTekTteUvKpuWKPDhCSsG6x3E-RwtbCnydLNcHWvErTkbAUZnkKhjafLYTLnFkoK2iKm0ESh4IFPXS9wtTIe-mwt5_l9zPF3zR2ehtXncCS0qnF05izqVA%3D%3D)
_Marjorie Dannenfelser
President SBA Pro-Life America_ Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ac73174cb5a444c9b841b4966f625d05&_e=J4rcGxegXNB6VAMhA19djRQGb6nVhf8mRvGjgmXtyp5agMKzS2i3HePUfFoJ8vwNxOCWThUhEnhas7y-1Mm7gA7bVsRstPYlpSInlu0LQpltwbQfiq-fYup1m_Wc499WmYVR5i-P29RD4ZfBpgyifzniOpO3pfewCFi29gfp1l-Nn4zajeSniPPsXGWK2z9_gXpXmLaIVCAld8YMWDRoVedJ-GVSjfUvh9mM3lA01x8Gw_46kUbUsHnpZXGmPZSpB-VuN7rgp8L5wVdzOvJeU66aF0-PwDGWVwrA1wNwZwJ9iGahjomldgQ6ghZxgL_RRCTeXYeuAd3Q-25Au29FfrZWb0WNHDVFvH_BBs1rrV-63qSCEIwn12O9-q5mDG5w_ePK0xVn1wpSdv2A5gO1DQ%3D%3D) For Life,
Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

We’re excited to endorse **Dan Rayfield as he runs for Attorney General**. Dan has earned an OLCV lifetime score of 95%, and is motivated to run for Attorney General to hold polluters accountable when they spoil our air and drinking water. We would also like to highlight another one of our endorsements, **Khanh Pham for Senate District 23**. Khanh has championed several environmental bills including 100% Clean Energy for All - HB 2021 in 2021, which has Oregon committed to 100% clean electricity by 2040. She has been a strong leader and advocate on climate issues, earning her an OLCV lifetime score of 100%. Another one of our endorsements is **Anthony Broadman for Senate District 27**. During his time as a Bend City Councilor, he has been a strong champion for safer alternative transportation options throughout the city and smart wildfire policy. We look forward to working with him in the State Senate! For those in Deschutes County, we are happy to endorse the re-election of **Phil Chang for Deschutes County Commissioner**. Phil has been a longtime conservation advocate and he’s continued to champion conservation, wildfire prevention, and drought resilience policy as a Deschutes County Commissioner. name: Katie Porter
subject: Can you help me support progressive candidates in meaningful races all across the country?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38792%2E3422442%2EQHA3sQ)
Derek,
Today I want to tell you about one of the organizations that supported me in my U.S. Senate race, the Progressive Change Campaign Committee (PCCC).
**The PCCC is committed to supporting progressive Democrats in competitive races all across the country, up and down the ballot.** From supporting Senate candidates like Ruben Gallego in Arizona and Sherrod Brown in Ohio, to supporting progressive candidates in meaningful state legislature and school board races, they’re working to move the needle on important priorities like Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and Wall Street reform.
As my mentor, Elizabeth Warren (who has also been supported by the PCCC), always says, _nobody gets elected alone._
After running in several competitive races, I know that to be true. Organizations like the PCCC provide financial support and training, which is especially important to new progressive candidates breaking into politics.
**[If you’d like to help us elect progressives all across the country, consider making a donation today that will be split between the PCCC and my organization, Truth to Power, which is committed to supporting Democrats who reject corporate PAC money.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240321-pccc?refcode=em20240321-38792&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38792_3422442_QHA3sQ&akid=38792%2E3422442%2EQHA3sQ)**

Katie Porter

name: Hill Harper
subject: Why I’m not taking a CENT of corporate PAC money
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
We can’t keep letting corporations buy politicians and votes.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1103%2E62735%2E495fFx)
Get this, Peter: **As of two months ago, outside spending in the 2024 election cycle soared to nearly $318 million. And soon enough, we’ll learn just how much more has been dropped.**
This dynamic is totally unacceptable, if you ask me.
Election after election, outside groups pour millions of dollars into races across the country to support (a.k.a buy) candidates who will vote the way THEY want them to in Congress.
It’s all part of our broken campaign finance system that gives corporations and the ultra-wealthy outsized influence in Washington. Me, on the other hand? I can’t be bought, bossed, or bullied by _anyone._
**I was approached by one of AIPAC’s biggest donors and offered $20 million — in exchange for dropping out of this Senate race to run against Rep. Rashida Tlaib — and you better believe I turned it down.** Sure, $20 million in a Congressional race can decide the outcome of a race, but I also know that donor was looking for a return on this investment. That’s a promise I can’t make because I will _always_ vote in the interests of Michigan’s working families — no one else.
**[I’m not taking a CENT of corporate PAC money, and with my end-of-quarter deadline coming up next week,_every dollar counts right now._ Please, chip in ASAP to support our people-powered, grassroots campaign for Senate >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/go/798?t=2&akid=1103%2E62735%2E495fFx)**
Peter, this much is certain: We won’t secure the change we need by sending the same bought-and-paid-for politicians to Washington.
**It’s those same career politicians who aren’t doing a thing** to lower the cost of prescription drugs (votes bought by Big Pharma) or get weapons of war off our streets (votes bought by the NRA).
**It’s those same career politicians who promise that they’ll change the system** once they’re elected — only for them to step off the plane in Washington and head right to a steak dinner with lobbyists.
It’s those same career politicians who pretend to be one of us, who pretend to understand our struggles while ignoring our most basic priorities: safer communities, affordable housing, higher wages, universal health care, and more.
Enough is enough. **Working families deserve someone in their corner for a change, and I’m running from the outside — not as a career politician — to ensure our voices are echoed in the halls of power.**
**[The irony is that because I’m not taking corporate PAC money, I’m at a _serious_ disadvantage, Peter. So please, chip in any amount to help hit our critical end-of-quarter goal and power our grassroots campaign to victory >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/go/798?t=3&akid=1103%2E62735%2E495fFx)**
_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth. LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS [] Canvass for Lily Franklin! On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event! Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645. South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018 [] Canvass for Sam and Trish! this is a place holder until the new facebook event is created Join us Sunday to canvass for Sam and Trish! Meet our Field Coordinator, Dom, on September 3rd at the Williamson Road Library, 12:00pm. Located at 3837 Williamson Rd, Roanoke, VA 24012. IN THE COMMUNITY [] [] Roanoke River Contamination Settlement Reached Roanoke Young Democrats Canvass Tailgate Without current regulations, the water contamination caused by these companies could have been so much worse. Fall into wellness at the Harvest Festival! Read More Celebrate the end of farm season with fun experiences for the whole family. Try new activities to support your well-being. Connect with others in a beautiful outdoor space. Free meals available with registration. This event is free and open to everyone! Read More [] [] [] Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4 Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research. Peter, After the 9/11 attacks, I made the decision to serve in uniform to protect the values that America represents. I joined the US Navy Reserve serving as an Intelligence Officer, and during that time, I witnessed the incredible sacrifices that my fellow service members make in order to serve our country. I’ll never forget the people I served alongside. I admire how, no matter what was thrown their way, they never asked for anything in return. We all know that all our nation's service members deserve to return home knowing that they will be taken care of, but so often, they are not. In 2022, when Congress finally took **bipartisan action** to help veterans who were exposed to toxic substances during their service by passing the _PACT Act,_ guess who voted no? No, it wasn’t some of the well-known GOP extremists. Ted Cruz voted yes, and so did Matt Gaetz, **but AZ-01's very own representative and my opponent, David Schweikert, voted no.** Schweikert then had the nerve to brag to his constituents about all his work helping veterans and encouraged them to sign up for the very benefits he so adamantly voted against. You really can’t make it up. The utter disregard for our service members and veterans is disqualifying. Arizonans deserve to have a representative who understands and protects our veterans, not a hypocrite who’s focused on only serving the wants and needs of Donald Trump’s agenda. clean_body: Arizonans deserve to have a representative who understands and protects our veterans, not a hypocrite who’s focused on only serving the wants and needs of Donald Trump’s agenda. | = Peter, After the 9/11 attacks, I made the decision to serve in uniform to protect the values that America represents. I joined the US Navy Reserve serving as an Intelligence Officer, and during that time, I witnessed the incredible sacrifices that my fellow service members make in order to serve our country. I’ll never forget the people I served alongside. I admire how, no matter what was thrown their way, they never asked for anything in return. We all know that all our nation's service members deserve to return home knowing that they will be taken care of, but so often, they are not. In 2022, when Congress finally took bipartisan action to help veterans who were exposed to toxic substances during their service by passing the PACT Act, guess who voted no? No, it wasn’t some of the well-known GOP extremists. Ted Cruz voted yes, and so did Matt Gaetz, but AZ-01's very own representative and my opponent, David Schweikert, voted no. Schweikert then had the nerve to brag to his constituents about all his work helping veterans and encouraged them to sign up for the very benefits he so adamantly voted against. You really can’t make it up. The utter disregard for our service members and veterans is disqualifying. Arizonans deserve to have a representative who understands and protects our veterans, not a hypocrite who’s focused on only serving the wants and needs of Donald Trump’s agenda. body:
[View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kMtOwzAQRb9msmvkGTt2u_ACGoVFoUIIFixdP1pXMUntlKh_j1oK23mce3RNGvsYLhrUIxAdoitABPwBiE6fc8rnY9o8Ldrt83FxktvUXLe0BqLpMvr_0zul9snE_jpVbeU0D46JymtUiIyvGMnqoO3KBNxZ5kgpT0HIBsWSmiYw6w0ZXkVNjATjhCi5FLxGhcavgjCNWwZsHAh2y6lN8jlag2WaTc7DkGo7pKrXh2kay02sA-rmPNRfZ9v7c_l9s0MC6u7KQN03UJenlsrbx-79FXh3a4G3m_nluN57iVXWbpxj38ciFQi2_8P8BAAA__-Jh2Bg)

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I’m praying that you’ll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **– murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn’t happen to my son, _I wouldn’t even believe it._ **[And I’m praying you will help me save my son](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)** – **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon’s death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence’s legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon’s system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn’t believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**“guilty.”**_

He’s currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they’re trying to put my son – a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations – away for 60 years for something he _didn’t_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** –or LELDF for short.

If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They’re also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)**

**Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence’s team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you – in advance – for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence’s spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note –maybe a prayer?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbMhkfqwDz4sc5zD0mBIBww7GYpFNSqs2vUHgv77IUG26-MDyefSNMTwVYPdAeI1-gUQgb4B4uefW5q39_TjkDen43v-aU5J36f4HRDXr4n_q88tBScXhzu1TeZrCl6ojGtppRRUCTTZtRYlU9BlqQTpyrAgQ7byJMvSOG-1z2KNApUglNKQUVRIKx1XQTntyyC1ByUedwqXeI69k8t6c_M8jqnox5QN9XVdp-XxWAvYLtxvMxfug_243g3AduDBB8BWBzYVBp9bcaFc9Szy6qI5l05dVFlqZ8kBtduaumXc5p6Bml1zyM_7E6C548Q-bgmo2b88Se_S5OLbB1DzL6TbNYfuuD82bff6cvzZnfen7vVX_vuczbWfbnEY4mIsKPH26OrH9DcAAP__zSB5DQ)** There’s a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you –from the bottom of my heart.
––––––––

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. body:
This week, the Supreme Court hears whether the government can fight misinformation.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81393610/462301957/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjI1MmU2MTQtYTJlNy1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Gq4ap4nvNpfBIvoIFQhcdw0kto_eXoJaRqoeqT3xy_8=&emci=83d1e95a-f6e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=6252e614-a2e7-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., presidential candidate and conspiracy theory superspreader, could soon be handed a big win from the right-wing Supreme Court.

Conservatives and conspiracy theorists like RFK are teaming up to make an absurd free-speech argument, claiming they can post whatever they want on social media, regardless of the consequences to our democracy.

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

Friend,

It’s Wesley Hunt.

As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I’m running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=55d370f50e7a4ea18ce6c0c360db5b65&_e=2RPYMqBPsfquxvAby_s-a8R8VyQaKa6Tm5hzq8BgEeLwqv4EofIHwGA4Jj4A_GvPx-9QyL9xlXZlBqs7vstAqt9bqJUSh_QQOB77RVhTiizWzBkTX7ST-TOQGoBtWVK7gu96fQ-MzKSTkGwSSN4xdkuyt5m13Mse9uoTaKkDHHWp_eJki-aC3vgENt043xBnx6cFmVcDYuFR0NW4LJV76zckcwlhKDvn1U9exVensIJUgZEgyZ_c7vsAvViaTMktGvgE1-SDxKUZa1jt27FLYz19BDvznaIn3q8gB0YAVFA%3D) _(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress.

I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn’t be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights.

**Join me in the fight to save the future of America.**

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=55d370f50e7a4ea18ce6c0c360db5b65&_e=2RPYMqBPsfquxvAby_s-a8R8VyQaKa6Tm5hzq8BgEeLwqv4EofIHwGA4Jj4A_GvPx-9QyL9xlXZlBqs7vstAqt9bqJUSh_QQOB77RVhTiizWzBkTX7ST-TOQGoBtWVK7gu96fQ-MzKSTkGwSSN4xdv6PnOyEWi10QuuQnCFGKItwwdoTeCqSPpUOtm7sIEGa9qoZpv5074zKRzli7ozxFvgy8kI6l-IwijmOgYy_KkjrpcmnNT9ccw3yziHzcKwHpwB7JsD4ke9Zyp2bubTWBi6fLn4Tt3vZ9NWIBygCPCE%3D)

**This picture** is my number one reason for serving Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation.

Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day.

**Nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and community here at home.

| [**JOIN TEAM HUNT - DONATE TODAY**](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=55d370f50e7a4ea18ce6c0c360db5b65&_e=2RPYMqBPsfquxvAby_s-a8R8VyQaKa6Tm5hzq8BgEeLwqv4EofIHwGA4Jj4A_GvPx-9QyL9xlXZlBqs7vstAqt9bqJUSh_QQOB77RVhTiizWzBkTX7ST-TOQGoBtWVK7gu96fQ-MzKSTkGwSSN4xdjBT5_u35G_JLPzazRcu_UVOQ-KmQrvuG-qVnpuuXynzdkQXNC8rEOm3yFW7Wkirj9uESZ7nhjF953Qs2D3nrdeeW3DBBU5yIwZFOSU_LPA493esFJE9HN1WtzU1SOPSMdLq2mvX3f8_Sg1UzA-a95A%3D)
---

I hope you’ll join me as we fight to put an end to all the damage the Left has done over the past three years.**

Thank you,

Wesley Hunt

Hi -
Michael from Climate Defiance here.
In less than a year, our scrappy group of youth climate activists has amassed a major following and earned a reputation as a group that does not mess around.
With a shoestring budget and only a few full-time organizers, we have reached over 70 million people on twitter. We have been in the [New York Times](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=1742a0b1db&e=c0a1c11fc3) on multiple occasions. We are getting phone calls from people who report directly to the President. We played a major, major role in spurring the President to protect 13,000,000 acres in the Arctic from drilling.
Less than a month after our meeting with Senior Advisor to the President John Podesta, the White House announced they would pause construction of new Liquified Gas export terminals, a major, major victory for the climate movement.
We’re doing all this with a very limited budget. Can you [donate today](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=9ba9c42aab&e=c0a1c11fc3) to help us increase the amount of actions we pull off?
| [Donate to Disrupt Climate Criminals](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=584d59a549&e=c0a1c11fc3)
---
In less than a year, we’ve developed relationships with leading progressives in Congress, including Ro Khanna, Ayanna Pressley, Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and Rashida Tlaib. These leaders count on us continuing to take the fight to Big Oil and their sycophants.
Our movement will never have the funds to out-spend or out-advertise the fossil fuel industry. But we have our voices. Our spirits. Our bodies. Through that we can change the culture. Change the law. Change, eventually, the parts per million of carbon in the atmosphere.
When we get millions of views for chasing coal baron Joe Manchin or the CEO of Exxon Mobil off various podiums, we all at once shake them, shake the public, and change the conventional wisdom about what's "politically feasible." And we get media sources like the Washington Post and the Times to finally pay attention.
We will not stop creating viral moments that embarrass climate criminals and shake the public awake. Donate [here](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=57c74fcca3&e=c0a1c11fc3) and help us take our energy to the next level.
-Michael

In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Barry Hinckley, a successful entrepreneur, former candidate for the US Senate, and a constitutional activist. Barry shares his story of growing up in Maine, working for the family boatbuilding business, and eventually founding a successful startup. Inspired by the Tea Party movement, Barry then ran for the US Senate in Rhode Island before founding another company and beginning his current mission to get 25 million signatures for the [Redeclaration of Independence](https://substack.com/redirect/58dafb25-bb05-4f80-a882-3ba1f65cb4fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The episode is filled with tidbits of wisdom that he picked up along his fascinating journey. Barry ends the conversation with timeless advice that will help us all navigate uncertainty (and life): Take care of your body and tend to your health.

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)
Did you see this message from Bob, Peter?
Nobody knows Pennsylvania like Bob does. Now, his PA map is back and bigger than ever, and we’re covering it with the names of supporters from all across the Commonwealth.
**[Support from folks like you will make or break our effort to re-elect Bob and send him back to the Senate to fight for Pennsylvania families. SoPeter, donate any amount right now to stake your spot on the map. We’re hoping to cover the Commonwealth with the names of Team Casey supporters!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240321-2?refcode=em20240321-2&refcode2=2406_552475_QfGz5Z&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)**
Thanks, Peter.
— Team Casey
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Bob Casey** <info@email.bobcasey.com>
Date: Mar 20 2024 at 9:43 AM
Subject: The map is back
The map is back, Peter.
In 2020, while the Nation waited for every vote to be counted in the presidential election between Joe Biden and Donald Trump, I spent a week in front of my map of Pennsylvania breaking down what was happening.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240321-2?refcode=em20240321-2&refcode2=2406_552475_QfGz5Z&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)
It caught on, and I got a reputation for being a bit of a map guy.
Then in 2022, I pulled out the map again to break down Pennsylvania’s vote tallies until my friends Senator John Fetterman and Governor Josh Shapiro officially won their historic victories.
Now, the map is back and it’s better (and bigger) than ever — and we’re covering it with the names of supporters from all across the Commonwealth.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240321-2?refcode=em20240321-2&refcode2=2406_552475_QfGz5Z&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)
What happens in Pennsylvania will determine the fate of our entire country. If we lose this race, Democrats could lose both the Senate and the White House – impacting everything from women’s rights to the promise of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. If we’re going to win this thing, it’s going to take an army of supporters like you, Peter, chipping in when you can.
We’re going to continue covering our map of Pennsylvania from top to bottom with the names of supporters like you — because grassroots donors will make all the difference in our fight to defend Pennsylvania’s seat and hold our Senate majority.
[**Will you stake your spot on the map today? Donate any amount right now, and we’ll add your name.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240321-2?refcode=em20240321-2&refcode2=2406_552475_QfGz5Z&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)
**[Get on the map ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240321-2?refcode=em20240321-2&refcode2=2406_552475_QfGz5Z&akid=2406%2E552475%2EQfGz5Z)**
Thank you for being on my team.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

body:
# [#]
# [#]
Peter,

Happy Women’s History Month!

This month, it’s important for us to take time to recognize and celebrate the women across the globe who have helped to make our world a better and more equitable place.

Honoring this month is especially important to me because Women’s History Month began right here in Sonoma County when the Education Task Force of the Sonoma County Commission on the Status of Women created Women’s History Week in 1978. Now, almost 50 years later, we spend the entire month of March celebrating the rich achievements and accomplishments of women throughout history.

There is a lot for us to celebrate this month, but it’s also important that we recognize that there is still a lot of hard work ahead of us.

And so, while we still have a long road ahead of us, please join me this month in honoring women of the past, present, and future.

Women have played a vital role in the preservation of our democracy and the advancement of our nation. Women’s history is American history.

Thank you for your support and for all that you do.

– Mike

body:
The Governor has 30 Days to Act
| | | |
GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 18 DAYS LEFT TO ACT
UPDATE 3/21/24
APRIL 8 DEADLINE
---
---
| Friends, Here is the most current list of bills Governor Youngkin has either signed into law, vetoed or amended. Any of the 2,000 plus bills that the governor does not act on become law.
There are still over 40 gun control bills on the Governor's desk. Please contact Governor Youngkin's office now and encourage the Governor to vote against any bill that targets law abiding citizens. All of these links are listed below.
Govenor Youngkin has already vetoed these 2 gun control bills on his desk:
HB 46 Firearm; transfers to another person from a prohibited person. SB 47 Firearm; transfers to another person from a prohibited person.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.
---

body:
VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd

Fellow American,

Election Day is fast approaching and #TeamMackenzie is working harder than ever!

The message that our volunteers and I deliver to voters is simple: I am the only candidate with a proven track record of getting conservative legislation passed. And, I am the only candidate with a proven track record of winning elections, defeating the Democrats, and being in a position to fight for our conservative agenda.

In Congress, I will continue to fight for you just like I have as a member of the State House. Whether the issue is tackling illegal immigration, fighting out-of-control spending, protecting the 2nd Amendment, or fighting the woke agenda, I have always fought on your side - and achieved real results.

I went to Harrisburg to represent my constituents, and have been honored to be re-elected by them in every campaign I have run. That’s one BIG thing that separates me from the other candidates in this race: I am the only one who has WON elections! Now, I’m ready to take the fight right to Susan Wild – and win again for all of us. I hope you’ll join the team.

As always, we had another busy week on the campaign trail. Here are just a few highlights:

• ENDORSED! Sydney Wernett: Jim Thorpe Borough Council

• WFMZ profile

• St. Patrick's Day Parade

• Blue Mountain Rod and Gun Club

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

-Ryan Mackenzie

ENDORSED! Sydney Wernett: Jim Thorpe Borough Council

I am always proud to receive the endorsement of strong conservative women in PA-7. This week, it’s Jim Thorpe Borough Council Member Sydney Wernett joining the team. Sydney is a champion for conservative causes and represents Carbon County residents well on Jim Thorpe Borough Council. Why is Sydney endorsing Ryan? “Because Ryan will be a fighter for us in D.C. like he has been here in the Pennsylvania House.”

WFMZ profile
What do voters need to know about me? That I am America First proven conservative who isn’t afraid to let people know where I stand on the issues. This week, WFMZ highlighted my message in a candidate profile. Check it out here:
WFMZ ARTICLE (https://www.wfmz.com/news/area/lehighvalley/proven-conservative-ryan-mackenzie-runs-for-congress-in-pa-s-7th-district/article_e9b73c44-df36-11ee-8414-ff11e77a9fe4.html)

St. Patrick’s Day Parade

On Sunday, I attended the Allentown St. Patrick’s Day Parade with members of #TeamMackenzie. The highlight of the Parade was the off-the-charts positive response we received all along the parade route! It was awesome to see so many familiar faces and receive so much support and encouragement from many people I didn’t know as well. The thing binding us all together - we are ready for change in Washington! Thank you to everyone who was there rooting me on!

Also interesting - Susan Wild’s float was not far from us on the parade route, and the people of Allentown were letting her have it! They were booing and yelling at her along the way about how the Democrats and their policies were ruining our country. The People are ready for a change, and we’re going to give it to them!

Blue Mountain Rod and Gun Club

I recently spoke to members of the Blue Mountain Rod and Gun Club about how we are losing our country to the radical left. Thanks to everyone in attendance, and those who agreed to join our team that night!

#TeamMackenzie and I continue to work hard every single day as we head toward the Primary on April 23rd, and then straight to the General Election in November! Sarah McBride is no stranger to making history.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240321-1&t=1&akid=478%2E587540%2EOYsZ96)
Peter,
We are working with a lot of inspiring candidates this election cycle, but today I want to tell you about one race in particular that I’m excited about: **Sarah McBride** , our newly endorsed candidate for Delaware’s at-large seat in the U.S. Congress.
**[But first, can you split $5 to Sarah's campaign and Leaders We Deserve? Together, we're electing young progressives like Sarah all across the country.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-20240321-1?refcode=em20240321-1&amount=5&refcode2=478_587540_OYsZ96&akid=478%2E587540%2EOYsZ96)**
Sarah is no stranger to making history: in 2016, she became the first openly transgender person to address a national party convention. When she was elected to the Delaware State Senate in 2020, she became the first transgender state senator in the entire country. **And when we help her win in November, she’ll break new ground as the _first ever_ transgender member of Congress.**
During her time as a state legislator, Sarah has already earned an impressive record of victories and real results for the people of her district, including passing paid family and medical leave, an assault weapons ban and other significant gun safety reform, and a number of bills protecting reproductive freedom in Delaware.
And just this week, she announced new legislation to secure the largest ongoing investment in Delaware’s Medicaid program since the Affordable Care Act.
Sarah is a proven changemaker who we need working for Delaware and all of us in Congress alongside a Democratic majority next year. We’re all in on this race!

#
Friends,

Here is a quick update on the $1 trillion “minibus” spending package being negotiated in Congress right now to avoid a partial government shutdown on Friday.

We don’t have all the details, because _Speaker Mike Johnson is working with Democrat Hakeem Jeffries_ behind closed doors, but here’s what we know:

**This deal would fund the government, including woke and weaponized programs** , through the end of 2024. DEI, Title 1, “climate resilience” programs, Democrats are already bragging about what’s in this spending package on Twitter.

**At least 40 Republicans in the House oppose the deal** , which is why Mike Johnson is working with Democrats to pass it, and why they have so far not released the text of the bill.

**The price tag for this deal is $30 billion MORE than we had under Nancy Pelosi** and would add to our $34.5 trillion national debt.

**Call your members of Congress and tell them to VOTE NO on the “minibus.”**

The worst part? [As I told Steve Bannon on War Room](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5a19e63614&e=17913c7d6d), Republican leaders will claim this is a good deal because it gives more money for border security.

Yes, they are going to look you in the eyes and tell you giving more money to the DHS, whose Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas has overseen the invasion at our southern border by millions of illegals and who House Republicans JUST VOTED to impeach, is going to help the situation at the border.

It’s a bold-faced lie and will do nothing to secure our southern border.
---

| The only reason we know all of this is because it’s been leaked to the press and operatives working for both parties, instead of giving the American public 72 hours to read the bill before they jam it through with a vote in the 11th hour.

It’s DC cartel politics. It’s a disgrace. The time for a long leash is over... Mike Johnson is governing with Democrats now.

**Call your members of Congress and tell them to VOTE NO on the “minibus.”**
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Citizens for Renewing America

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUcYtyUFMqA3BJzE2z1FRNf_a4Mz60b51kWIoBBSR9RCAU7G2iue2V_W149C02w6EaNJ_XznnUPf-WhQVNZIYuUwsmiuIdJbKmrQJDPrWjBfTxIkWUeERQvbQe3P4Ej1rx20bMdCA24S7U00feewFq33w%3D%3D)

**But here’s where I need your help – the rich continue to run Congress because they have the funds to do so._But I have you..._**

[**I’m relying on the support of grassroots donors who want to see real change happen in America. Will you make a donation to my campaign to send a hard-working American, who actually understands the struggles of life, back to Washington?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUcNlpJdWrk-apWZpBy_e20Dgwql6CFuz06MYmhnbf06eNRLZLue-1s3pMvoS5ktx1KSt5g1pnY3jZ5XVWfC2hsKjmhmLYIlFNWspaShg6C_DqVUrlGeQ-1jUDIwCmNPEOWm1vgIHccyIe-rQPy1Mgxwg%3D%3D)

[** ****SEND ME BACK TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUc8jKfKc2Fj7bLyAPAsWUcfNXh3Vodt07gEgnGfEq5NHS5YlzaPM2h29xK9mi8NVYnEkoGsZktrTvk3NJAVP4S4UIWRFpZSnWugmbwa4Ry__znD2vdf1YU-PHIJo0Qq_enU9JXNlaknt6T_9l2qxstGw%3D%3D)

I have no friends in Washington, Fellow American because I don’t play into the bull**** swamp and I can’t be bought. The only people I work for are the American people, [**which is why everyone is trying to boot me out of office and buy this seat for someone they can puppeteer.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUcDCl3KNFwuRLBE3GNzlYAxlULbiPKQRQE_Y2OJpjp8RKKIUUvVu5XxyYEgOSSzZgA1rUrD-tpaOSNlJvT7IUH0mOe10rywiHIVuoI7wAiXL2vMlL14mtRcp_M-IHj7A4vcawcUNMd5AfyDhjjistR5w%3D%3D)

[**But I’ll never stop fighting.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUccnb8pFywxRNEbJWHQBgQdzu--JlBq_Or0rh9m4-SkJbvosznLaxI96QJ9RtgEW1SwkTRvmja_WfRVOSTD0cEHX_NMYPJOPRopVjK6rmVSXwUazba9t_TvcUbYC5w2fymOYDusT-F02QKqGG52PwrqA%3D%3D) I learned a long time ago that I have to fight for the things I believe in, _and I believe in America._

There was a time in my life when I never thought I would graduate high school, let alone serve in Congress. I’ve never forgotten the feeling of being 17, so lost and confused but also filled with so much ambition to make a life for myself.

I am taking the same ambition to Congress, to fight for you. [**Join me and let’s shake up Congress together.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4906277fed0d40c2911e2f5b708744fe&_e=_rEVk3Qi8ooOhaeln0MrrQKH_b3uZGHPxAD6aRVfnZFOUbEf9w3Xg5jPmWnHnCwWbcBcRIRI9WkIwZcqV-xlqU-WcvvyQW90jOzrSbgmC4uHolLfv-4E32iKOJPpBQMfWLwfTfByPc3mIwO1Sszm__efgxzg2V2W5ILFjcnbdiamT-YnKuTskj7mDDCS5cFsZyhd70bISDQngj043Kt9iNZ0rA5N5c05-2GgH9TKgF5Jafy50j-9gXEBle5dkKUcht5KQl1mhBLWOt39kkIZMnLOoCRNyiST5kAZgrp1iku_5fqAudWFtx9wXGrxJuNLXt0lkSyRFF-7qHsXrRdFjISiDKr6jlQ-03WIzMXhhLOye0UEWnwmPV4mpFqjgJjBMxM1Z9t8UGeXD7UGip-QDw%3D%3D)

Nancy Mace

Fellow Conservative,

\*\*I just secured the official GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in Ohio!\*\*

Sherrod Brown is the single biggest enabler of Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda that has wrecked our country. He is:

1. For open borders – and even more illegal immigration.

2. Soft on crime – and more focused on protecting criminals than putting them in jail.

3. For runaway spending – he’s never met a dollar he couldn’t spend.

4. For nonstop taxes on hardworking Ohio families.

5. And a career politician who first ran for office when Richard Nixon was president.

\*\*Sherrod Brown votes with Joe Biden damn near 100% of the time.\*\* He’s sabotaged Ohio, and he’s sabotaged America, _and he’s lied to Ohio workers every step of the way._

I’ve got a message for them... \*\*I wear my support for President Trump like a badge of honor and am proud to have his support because under him, we were safe, prosperous, and at peace.\*\*

I wonder if Sherrod Brown would wear his blind support of Joe Biden and his policies like a badge of honor?

We know that DC Democrats will stop at nothing and spend whatever it takes to keep the chief enabler of their disastrous agenda in the Senate. \*\*That’s why I need your help, fellow conservative.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=3327357.1428.1.73a1027c07053ed39551145bada9a3f1 )

Bernie Moreno

Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

The GOP’s core strategy is to take back power by undermining our democracy. So here’s the NDRC’s 10 Year Plan to fight back:
**→ Electoral Investment:** Strategic political and electoral engagement throughout the decade – we will build power so that we can shift power, to put the right people in the right places.

**→ Grassroots Mobilization and Public Education:** We will mobilize our supporters to be engaged in efforts that are built toward fair redistricting, including working toward a fair and accurate 2030 Census.

**→ Accountability Efforts:** The NDRC and its affiliates will move the needle toward representative democracy by holding legislators accountable to their voters. That means playing defense to protect good process and fair maps, while going on offense to enforce the Voting Rights Act and challenge racial and partisan gerrymanders.

**→ Redistricting Reform:** Advancing redistricting reforms and policy changes at both the state and the federal level – we are already shaping improved redistricting processes in states that faltered during this past redistricting cycle.

Friends,
We are excited to share that our Illinois Freedom Caucus members who faced contested primaries _**all won re-election**_ on Tuesday.
And it wasn't even close.
The results of the elections are significant because the Establishment burned over $700,000 to try and unseat our members, the most significant funding of which came from the state's teachers' unions.
If you recall, Illinois Democrats, at the behest of their teachers' union puppetmasters, [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/c8c8ee31-caa1-4471-890b-b98ac1c60a74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the state's only school choice program, which expired at the end of FY2023. Our Illinois Freedom Caucus members, while unsuccessful, played a prominent role in the fight to save the program and making it a national story.
When you think of teachers' unions donating to lawmakers, you probably assume it means funding Democrats. But over the last few years, [they've](https://substack.com/redirect/7ee8f9b1-4fab-4e07-a436-c7679ccbec52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) quietly began working to elect "Republicans" that will do their bidding.
And in response to the support Illinois Freedom Caucus members have for school choice, the state's largest teachers' unions poured money into Republican primary challenges against them.
ILFC member Rep. Blaine Wilhour faced the most opposition. The unions spent over $400,000 to unseat him. That was 4x the amount of money that Blaine spent in the race.
The result? Blaine won with nearly 80% of the vote.
Freedom Caucus member Rep. Adam Niemerg also faced a coordinated attack that was just plain dirty. Democrats and teachers' unions conspired to successfully kick Niemerg off the ballot based on a technicality. Adam was then forced to run a "write-in" campaign, while the Left recruited their own "write-in" fake Republican candidate. The unions then poured over $300,000 into attacking Adam's record.
Since it's a "write-in" race, they are still counting the ballots, but Adam is leading with over 90% of the vote.
In addition, Rep. Brad Halbrook overwhelmingly defeated a RINO primary challenger with 68% of the vote. And on top of it all, ILFC-endorsed candidate Regan Deering won her primary in an open seat with nearly 70% of the vote.
Not only did our members torch the Springfield special interests that tried to unseat them, but they even increased their ranks.
The lesson here? When you push strong conservative policies, the voters will reward you. The future is bright for the Illinois Freedom Caucus.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

subject: Reproductive rights are under attack

body:
| | | Peter, In a radio interview this week, Donald Trump signaled that he would support a nationwide ban on abortion.1 **Over 170 House Republicans — including Speaker Mike Johnson — doubled down yesterday by releasing a budget proposal that would legislate that life begins at _conception._ 2** And it’s not just abortion rights that are on the ballot this November. Everywhere you look, Republicans are chipping away at our reproductive rights. **[Will you rush a contribution of $10, or whatever you can afford, to help us defend reproductive rights and elect WFP champions in critical races across the country who will defend our rights in Congress?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9s2IUA5KU46HbmmYQxeoC18XnXVDozJftTxmaLZaJVae3a88Vvn9OT8pDwY0g7JRb4R7Aaee3NFBSAkkqOBlyv30qKonbUzeh5dxF0vNfcnH07PiFGCiQkq4xrEyGGmhmC9cCUMwxEFGmVSwJ3YI1eVv2yCXkWLmursKFe1bbi78fD5c5o_T6ZGiDTn2YU-cvAmF4JBNqxp0AY8gVJ7WzpjQ2W6a1zhOtrOvtOM-ZG3AbxFmvidlB0haZN0R95JTgZwajMhAtJLzETV2ONvhVwUNPQILlxzEHYWDr5XQPIwEhRwLvxKK3QRl10F81L1tOvJer7DTBpGdlykDVcd5mpz8yDqZ0Py7Ux9F5cGYWdlY/44u/q_Ex-ecRTiKZqxzRxW79Hg/h0/h001.mkz_8Q5k9VwNsP42jFooV3m4YkbcmqbYX5M-7rgdaag)** **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9s2IUA5KU46HbmmYQxeoC18XnXVDozJftTxmaLZaJVae3a88Vvn9OT8pDwY0g7JRb-7G9-q_2l-lX-XstN7kEbMbnbMbN4dyIDDlle43HrZIB7xgP4qIvb9LFrFJzp_tCC9DLeQ2Jp_YSpPFmextclSqunZeb1egB5SUuSBOxNxIdA00Q48WnLPiGL7mnWfjYsSBs8jLudEVtaLjbrj2aolKFBALbWR_5f3-eRQendap-HYNIUYrRNb0oLP9gebGL5V-TyYRQoeSTGX48DbYVfnrhFbFEXFrCmbrYCgObpbQNgB-tarTMfiS0ydf98v1lcUqlF_pyqh1z-ck5gUe1PMGZoNxkVuahmXiMwVtvPRw/44u/q_Ex-ecRTiKZqxzRxW79Hg/h1/h001.-52RsYl0AL-Q-xU3LdfJrJwnhV5RJoUBYzi5XktoPn0)** Ever since the Supreme Court struck down Roe, in state after state, we have seen our reproductive rights whittled away.
* In Louisiana, doctors have had to resort to providing medically invasive Cesarean section surgeries to get around the state’s anti-abortion law, when the life of the mother was at stake.3
* In Alabama, in vitro fertilization clinics were put into legal limbo after the state’s Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos are people. While the state has since passed a stopgap bill to allow families to continue to receive IVF treatments, at least one provider in the state has said the bill still does not give the legal protection they need to resume services.4
* In Congress, Republicans blocked a bill that would protect nationwide access to IVF treatments, despite claiming to support it.5
* Meanwhile, some red states are considering “fetal personhood” legislation that would not only put abortion and IVF treatments at risk, but could also result in legal challenges against certain types of contraceptives including some types of IUDs.6

What all of these attacks show is that the Republican Party isn’t just going after abortion rights, but all reproductive rights — and putting women’s health in jeopardy. **No matter if you live in a red, blue, or purple state — it is up to all of us to put a stop to these attacks and protect our fundamental right to bodily autonomy.** **[Will you contribute $10, or whatever you can afford, so we can reach voters across the country and elect WFP champions to Congress who will put an end to Republican control of the House and stand up for our rights?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9s2IUA5KU46HbmmYQxeoC18XnXVDozJftTxmaLZaJVae3a88Vvn9OT8pDwY0g7JRb4sDMHaYRlFKuSFd52mJqZ0j5tbVRnIZ_8S9dxmkVEIN5dH9FItewwB6LlUNhVW5CwrGpCoNxwtn8xBFl_2GOc8ZwPosBb7VEGkvedm94qOvwVd36G_-zb_Z6zn9PowCWIXbcYI2fUhrnWZ_1_7UBx65J7O-Agc5SsJo0pRkWrM2sLcL8YkozBckv5fBJFDkjF7aZTYyP5ZaPANKjbxC9rWlHwNgH0P7exLgqpFbdOEXKofGoDEtBWlQkNCr6QgJXf4VAyO9VFpWMglxuIYClhmou2jg6NDkdFLNAc_4xS6I/44u/q_Ex-ecRTiKZqxzRxW79Hg/h2/h001.JJMyLpwKGFlHN9z8nkjDYoCq1e_ecaH2_Id3jgXnI9M)** **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9s2IUA5KU46HbmmYQxeoC18XnXVDozJftTxmaLZaJVae3a88Vvn9OT8pDwY0g7JRb3B3uMKXmvmriIeVAq6MkRm5ehcBqfjSqMj6SYOEK6b2ku85HmN4lCQ5-HmQHbLDQ7DX4U9t68cuH3RSB0mBgvpWn3WnOYMDga4lfMToU-wLw4rkxT20itWbu5fio2F1UvrzO8xd7qhs76oFOfVMP8kJJzvsiacaM4NlISFN2bhgfZOZsoOmFQIYplzhlwlW1k6LCA2SZlYZYUS8T8Zz5HvWg-lADwfo5JDIRGhPnZ45AZypj8njMfHE8pC_9RpyQyW5hKyOZrfzV8UOWaIlNk5Ts8wqBm-eQhh_d31IPJVs/44u/q_Ex-ecRTiKZqxzRxW79Hg/h3/h001.p_sn4RGQprwfdt6SvyL1QF9DZTUqajSCwrye_EWiFMA)** In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. clean_body: | | | Peter, In a radio interview this week, Donald Trump signaled that he would support a nationwide ban on abortion.1 Over 170 House Republicans — including Speaker Mike Johnson — doubled down yesterday by releasing a budget proposal that would legislate that life begins at conception. 2 And it’s not just abortion rights that are on the ballot this November. Everywhere you look, Republicans are chipping away at our reproductive rights. Ever since the Supreme Court struck down Roe, in state after state, we have seen our reproductive rights whittled away. In Louisiana, doctors have had to resort to providing medically invasive Cesarean section surgeries to get around the state’s anti-abortion law, when the life of the mother was at stake.3 In Alabama, in vitro fertilization clinics were put into legal limbo after the state’s Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos are people. While the state has since passed a stopgap bill to allow families to continue to receive IVF treatments, at least one provider in the state has said the bill still does not give the legal protection they need to resume services.4 In Congress, Republicans blocked a bill that would protect nationwide access to IVF treatments, despite claiming to support it.5 Meanwhile, some red states are considering “fetal personhood” legislation that would not only put abortion and IVF treatments at risk, but could also result in legal challenges against certain types of contraceptives including some types of IUDs.6 What all of these attacks show is that the Republican Party isn’t just going after abortion rights, but all reproductive rights — and putting women’s health in jeopardy. No matter if you live in a red, blue, or purple state — it is up to all of us to put a stop to these attacks and protect our fundamental right to bodily autonomy.
