Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ee9ca10c43c24aa386d55baef2b1f013&_e=yv4l-nyZYGzNpadTflHTmtmjdYI8VYATcXqXmhM55kHStq7sZRMARuBJCLLqL3XSCwUtUWTR-BEZ4rM1_yKlik2Tni92DeTPck7arI8VNtGpzJJsT_F7d6DR_ot-yd8KmshXK7iTGZsTQdEnoNyTkI8k2bsZdPKRKRjn9W1IgUR2CmoA3QR0cHMe3GzQ1gjb2wlZoVU_uXJ7o_Fn8FOCqEIoNdown8ncGgBSF0QgRYRTHkMlfq2g4EgOJY1rtNOnt7m1Jw4_Apbt_ZIEcglZYMsl4Txxh4wlYUDUfxNjHz_gMtOqjfiI_iySfGIjXvw9AgsFYET4QQPKpxKIBADJmCF9DoYiXk9wrHmnTrynMyX7q9QYSaZmUUTiqBiq2t1q)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ee9ca10c43c24aa386d55baef2b1f013&_e=yv4l-nyZYGzNpadTflHTmtmjdYI8VYATcXqXmhM55kHStq7sZRMARuBJCLLqL3XSCwUtUWTR-BEZ4rM1_yKlik2Tni92DeTPck7arI8VNtGpzJJsT_F7d6DR_ot-yd8KmshXK7iTGZsTQdEnoNyTkI8k2bsZdPKRKRjn9W1IgUR2CmoA3QR0cHMe3GzQ1gjb2wlZoVU_uXJ7o_Fn8FOCqEIoNdown8ncGgBSF0QgRYQqDtfHuP336wHMJ0FK1RP0F51uWOMyR_5u9ZaPsdPkQD6va5SA17WTXjEOkulUMMVIB46PqYVlHHNIEAtvG7yypCZDjQKfV7q7PdJWX89Cm2qLw17AI6cgYMjOgzRfYnc1Wm8ndshRLlB7s1RZwrcH)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, **I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today**. Peter - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=58cd3e374f7e41bd905d3c7a6010747c&_e=b6ZRqzrqIp96yLS2uadGUSvx1Sf_DuRTLpqj_PKIvR1eIAkHmhRVjT9k1o5NQ1-GJLCrXsL9u7SYozt8dJkgHWfROElnTZrZuzWGIifvseQ3mBl-D9HyEhtzwKBDdi2fWCwZxW3EI5Kje-NG52Ytmc1zkrTdoO2pZnCRW1Ez8cYfszvEg3w6AzuBwtY7iwXEfqVmYcx3aZ8h7KOPvbdjzE6qJlCUkfnNbySdXIQLglQHSzL5SSwS9T3JNZmKQStv9wSPbAaM-gmIWeho7HxzVFt8ZFl1rwTWiJ4ncNU_r5T_HYQtkjgXpfxyDtSZtsXeD3vLPxLW_X95-H7B989tmayQLed4gBkWDu4K7MD6c_ONShCvwkapCciQ8NdY-GTl8q5GM_yOpffYPI0PLGoCxg%3D%3D)

body:
I hope this message finds you well and filled with the same passion and enthusiasm for progress that drives our campaign forward every single day. | | | | |
---
Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you well and filled with the same passion for progress that drives our campaign forward every single day. As we continue collecting signatures, I'm reaching out to invite you to be a part of our mission.
I am humbled to be working alongside impassioned community members like yourself to make MI-04 the best it can be. From economic prosperity to environmental sustainability, our campaign stands for the values that matter most to the hardworking families of our community. But to turn our vision into reality, **we need your support.**
**1\. Donate:** Your financial support is crucial to our success. Whether it's $5, $20, or $50, every dollar goes directly toward fueling our grassroots efforts and spreading our message.
| [Donate Now!](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=b41ee42e90&e=16d812e81c)
---
**2\. Volunteer:** Join our dedicated team who are working tirelessly to connect with voters, host events, and collect petition signatures. Your time and energy are invaluable resources in this fight for progress.
| [Get involved!]()
---

3\. Stay informed and spread the Word: Follow Joseph Alfonso on social media to stay up-to-date on our campaign events, policy proposals, and ways to get involved. Share our campaign updates on social media, talk to your friends and family about why you support our vision, and encourage others to join our movement for positive change.
| | | | [](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=13bf3b5b96&e=16d812e81c)| [](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=089ffd756c&e=16d812e81c)| [](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=6b9cf52f06&e=16d812e81c)

Your contribution, no matter what form it takes, will make a real difference in our ability to reach voters, organize grassroots events, and amplify our message of hope and progress. Together, we can build a campaign that reflects the diversity and strength of our community, and create a future where every person has the opportunity to thrive.
Thank you for all your help. Together, let's make history.
Best Wishes,Team Alfonso

Peter, there’s a myth about our campaign going around, and we need to address it. Friend -- The mysteries of the universe which have been watched by all peoples during all times of mankind's presence on earth, continue to inspire us with the magnificence of the unknown, and the unity of mankind when we pursue science rather than war. On April 8th of this year, 2024, people will travel from all ends of the earth to view the total eclipse that will be very apparent -- lucky for us -- in areas of New York State -- including Niagara Falls, Buffalo, Rochester and Syracuse. What will be happening in the heavens? In the Sare Symposium on Friday, March 24 the Sare Campaign's Astronomy Expert, Roger Ham, will present what can be seen on April 8th. The map linked here shows the trajectory of the total eclipse. [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240322_symposium&n=2) [https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/solar/2024-april-8](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=izSfqYyI_kxhTiUovoiqfLabDQcqz2_wTvNdSmJqGLMbFUR22hkEoIA5RCPPDtQa8vG0LFXyaoNIjXJQI9KADg&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240322_symposium&n=3) History is full of fascinating accounts of those viewing a solar eclipse -- when the sun disappears from view. Abraham Lincoln, Frederick Douglass, Marie Mitchell, Walt Whitman, Emily Dickinson and other voices have recorded their experiences when viewing such shocking events in the universe, including solar eclipses and the morning in 1833 when "the stars fell from the sky."

Join us this Friday at 8 pm to consider what the universe is trying to tell us in 2024.

name: Josh Harder
subject: My thoughts on the new poll
body:
Don't be discouraged.

Hey Peter, it’s Josh.
I know everyone is worried about the new poll showing me down by 4 points against my Republican opponent. I wanted to send you a personal note to share my thoughts.
When I first saw these numbers, I will admit that I was very discouraged. We’re working our hearts out to help our community, but clearly voters aren’t hearing about it. They are only hearing the negative attacks from the National GOP groups.
But I want to make sure we’re staying grounded here. We still have time to turn this around. We need to stay focused on what matters - doing good work and then having the funds to make sure voters know about it. **We know that if voters hear our message we win - but if they only see the national GOP attack ads, we lose.** So, let’s make sure they hear from us!
I’m not going to let this get me down and you shouldn’t either. It’s just another reminder of how competitive our race is going to be in November. Let’s use this as the motivation we need to keep this seat blue!
I hope I can count on your support in this important moment for our campaign.

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8f9ca07290264a46855fa74c6a58aa13&_e=GpLSrFvILl-ezcrUFnQ-yypPElPbTOMItUKTKxcBae1YjbLan8QTxN1OWUEZQH0VemnDAGUvPUlLlS1dndmTRjv9NdMkI_86HYMmjhJGEYuDzibSYxmQvpMcAhlz8jAo4YTt3BzFaCu5hILGcOkHD7BxxU-adtJ1SbA1AZ-qr0EhGhzrEubaIt5L_cuXnRjgRNW_yTWsWW6xSVVtqmJOm8BhTAyXwOwBJir0wYWUGyEbSxOLarlULtQQM_r-2UIYRiS1AfwFF3uJRNTRGEYh6NHrI-b3rS20gpUqD8y5A5mPfSXdM-kAql5xA3hqS-MVXbGevO_JpKJ1vMe_k0e2cmxNLL4MpoTU5-pyAbQZmxTpfAfYXvnC6hcvaD3zyAUiJNGOwUwyL5xSYczrwfjg_Q%3D%3D)

**_AP_ : UN weather agency issues ‘red alert’ on climate change after record heat, ice-melt increases in 2023**
* * *
The UN weather agency's recent “red alert” on climate change _should_ serve as an alarming call to action for all of our elected officials. In 2023, we witnessed ice loss from glaciers at a record-breaking pace and the lowest-ever Antarctic sea ice levels. Over 90% of our oceans faced heat wave conditions, posing a unique threat to marine life and disrupting global weather patterns. What’s worse, according to the World Meteorological Organization, there's a significant chance that 2024 will set _yet another_ record for high temperatures. **Let’s be clear: these unprecedented increases in greenhouse gas pollution, soaring land and water temperatures, and record-breaking ice-melt are the direct result of the greedy fossil fuel industry’s chokehold on our political system.** All of this is contributing to a massive humanitarian crisis — exacerbating food insecurity and displacing communities. Our most vulnerable bear the brunt of the climate crisis while the fat cats in the oil and gas industry rake in billions in profit. It's an injustice that demands immediate action. Here at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we’re fighting to elect climate champions who grasp the severity of this crisis and are prepared to take bold action against the fossil fuel industry that's driving it. **[Our planet's distress call must be answered with urgent, decisive action — not tomorrow, but today. Can we count on your donation of any amount in support of our mission to elect climate champions who aren’t beholden to Big Fossil Fuels?>>>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81411800/462354992/2105508926?refcode=ea.fd77d428-c4e7-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.fd77d428-c4e7-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkNzdkNDI4LWM0ZTctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QTN_anqJnqL7ovq8dJBmO1HdW6twzqT3O1uruubhjio=)** We know this all seems scary, but there is a glimmer of hope. Solutions exist. We know what works. It's just the political will that's lacking. clean_body: It’s all hands on deck. | AP : UN weather agency issues ‘red alert’ on climate change after record heat, ice-melt increases in 2023 The UN weather agency's recent “red alert” on climate change should serve as an alarming call to action for all of our elected officials. In 2023, we witnessed ice loss from glaciers at a record-breaking pace and the lowest-ever Antarctic sea ice levels. Over 90% of our oceans faced heat wave conditions, posing a unique threat to marine life and disrupting global weather patterns. What’s worse, according to the World Meteorological Organization, there's a significant chance that 2024 will set yet another record for high temperatures. Let’s be clear: these unprecedented increases in greenhouse gas pollution, soaring land and water temperatures, and record-breaking ice-melt are the direct result of the greedy fossil fuel industry’s chokehold on our political system. All of this is contributing to a massive humanitarian crisis — exacerbating food insecurity and displacing communities. Our most vulnerable bear the brunt of the climate crisis while the fat cats in the oil and gas industry rake in billions in profit. It's an injustice that demands immediate action. Here at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we’re fighting to elect climate champions who grasp the severity of this crisis and are prepared to take bold action against the fossil fuel industry that's driving it. = We know this all seems scary, but there is a glimmer of hope. Solutions exist. We know what works. It's just the political will that's lacking. That means you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, D.C. **[That's why I’m humbly asking you to rush an emergency $35 contribution to my campaign today.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=f04236f493084b4295cabf7990e5c9b0&_e=G8aJvaVfixdqVI-ObOXGXW_Be48b-AXzglONvXF6S_i0ytcMXIvE1QicuxxncWO9HfryAbx09lHHJFt-4PY1SCbVDffvwtUsNK5XCFnxKT8XGBBgJaRrNlyexIrHWFvLUem_XuKwPPnEaQOkT3KINKr2i639Gj3RtbJnYC3bML2OpCPPNXG5UnMVo1riqT5dgi8WJnHvBXM_3pEuSy3Emo3Rql0zS48LoaIcA-NeqTeNNKcTR1yrMR_IVu3YxANaife2WoHfvmDhPYIy_UIEqKup76sY8yxtCr_Ls__qZEbyDD8jWdcjjY1d_oe5D-hmm7Z4mNfcK_cQp6ldWKSDFTlicNr6wFTm51tCZPk8Avg0niSHwwuA9DAXiMauS_aS)** There’s no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it’s so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. We had to make a tough call recently, and we thought it was important that we explain it to you
#
Derek, we had to make a tough call recently, and we thought it was important that we explain it to you.
You’re one of our top supporters, so we felt we owed you that much.
The Republican controlled House and Speaker Johnson are showing us their priorities right now. They’re pursuing baseless political investigations, sham “impeachment”, and budgets that don’t come anywhere near addressing what the country needs or wants.
What they’re not doing is passing the bipartisan aid package that would support Ukraine in their fight against Russian aggression.
We’re fed up.
So last week we went up on television with a $100,000 ad buy on FOX News that used the words of Ronald Reagan against the GOP. We brought members and supporters, including Americans who fought in Ukraine, to Capitol Hill. And we ran our ad around DC, on a mobile billboard and on the RNC Headquarters itself.
This was a tough call — it took a lot of our resources to execute this plan. But we did it because it was the right thing to do. And since then, we’ve been inching closer and closer to getting aid across the finish line.
It's paying off.
Now, here’s the truth: We’re telling you all this because we need your help to refill our reserves. Everything VoteVets accomplishes happens because we’ve got the support of people like you. We’re proud of that, and you should be, too.

My time as an Army Ranger shaped who I am today. Folks, many people come to Congress and forget about why they ran in the first place. Not me. My time as an Army Ranger shaped who I am today. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81413677/462361585/-1943478937?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240321_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYjkzNDkyZS1jYWU3LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zajT_z14zh7qD58I-NiP1IE5M22SEWm015yjpZs-vy8=) I went active duty in the Army after 9/11. That took me on three tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. **The most important lesson I learned in those years was servant leadership.** I met some of the finest men and women during my time in the Army. There were Black soldiers, Hispanic soldiers, white soldiers, Asian soldiers. Some rich, some poor. Some were straight. Others gay. None of that mattered. What mattered was protecting each other. Through the gunfire. Through the battles. Through war. Even as I rose up to be Captain, I never forgot what it was like to walk in the shoes of a Private. My time as an Army Ranger shaped who I am today. = I went active duty in the Army after 9/11. That took me on three tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. The most important lesson I learned in those years was servant leadership. I met some of the finest men and women during my time in the Army. There were Black soldiers, Hispanic soldiers, white soldiers, Asian soldiers. Some rich, some poor. Some were straight. Others gay. None of that mattered. What mattered was protecting each other. Through the gunfire. Through the battles. Through war. Even as I rose up to be Captain, I never forgot what it was like to walk in the shoes of a Private. I was always the last to eat and the first to jump out of the plane. = We are living through an important moment in our history, and our country is calling on each and every one of us to step up. subject: Illinois lawmakers are trying to redefine child abuse
body:
A sinister bill is making its way through the Illinois legislature...

| |
---
| | I knew this was coming.A sinister bill is making its way through the Illinois legislature... ...and if it passes, it’s only a matter of time before other states – blue, purple, and red alike – adopt this policy.**Illinois House Bill 4876 would change the definition of “abused child” to include minors whose parents object to their children receiving puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, transgender surgeries, and abortions.** _It also conveniently shields doctors from liability if they prescribe these treatments to minors without parental consent._ The Center for American Liberty is actively fighting insanity just like this through our five ongoing lawsuits on behalf of both children and parents. **[**Will you join us today and give a generous tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to fund our cases and take a stand for parental rights?**](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyE0MGO2yAUheGnwTssuGCMF15k6ngUKUmrdKQuEeBLggROhLGqvn01Vbvu9l8c6Ts_LuZiY4rr_WozjrVUUzbjFuODTbTgWg0wkJQJCtyIZhllD4tQDY6855wpITlrHqN3WnNlO8cBh9ChVsoPXbA9Dk4zxZs4fu4wARy4GEC0jkEYOul0x3ulBCeS2YSlbm19YMHX7lL0dq1oc-ufuUnjo9bXRsSBwExgtisuz9qm6LDUXx7XiqV9ljuBGYS0rvOaSsSByoBItZaasm4JEIJUCyoi5r1msz334pGI6W16p7fjlYD6zBmXuGcipuPlb_E2v2y8r0RM_yDmbXo3X-bD2ZzO59P16-k7mNvxar4d6Mftoynj8voZU4qb6olk92xj-iOp_735dwAAAP__qpp8tg)** Because I know exactly how this ends if the transgender activists pushing this bill get their way._Doctors coerced Layla Jane into a double mastectomy at 13 years old.__Doctors coerced Chloe Cole into a double mastectomy at 15 years old.__Doctors coerced Luka Hein into a double mastectomy at 16 years old._ And all three regret the “gender affirming care” inflicted upon them.**Now the state of Illinois wants to put thousands of kids in their position – but without the opportunity to later file a medical negligence lawsuit against predatory doctors.** This is SICK. And worst of all, this bill gives the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) the power to remove children from their homes based on their new definition of an “abused child.”If this bill passes in Illinois, it’s only a matter of time before rabid leftists push for this in your state. In 2022, Central Florida put its trust in me – a Gen Z, working class, Afro-Latino organizer – and I became the first of my generation to ever be elected to Congress.

This win didn’t come easy, Peter. A _lot_ of people counted me out. They said that I was too young. That I didn’t have the “right” experience. That my generation didn’t deserve a seat at the decision-making table. They didn’t think I stood a _chance._

But people like you and The Collective PAC ignored all of that noise, and I was able to defy the odds._We did that._

**Now, our youth-powered movement has become a powerful force for change – and a direct threat to the status quo. That’s why fascist leaders in Florida, the gun lobby, and countless special interests are all plotting to replace me in this election.**

I’m ready to fight back, but I’m going to need YOU to join my team to win on Election Day, Peter.

# Standing Strong in this present world:
### The Call for Christians in the Political Arena!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/4c7186b4-0703-4a55-8760-0be30a4b6a7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4c7186b4-0703-4a55-8760-0be30a4b6a7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---

In the landscape of modern politics, the voice of Christians is crucial, echoing the principles upon which our nation was built and drawing from the wisdom of the Bible. As Christians, we are called to be active in the political arena, guided by the our Founding Fathers and the Bible. In a world of shifting ideologies and moral relativism, our steadfast commitment to truth and justice must shine brightly.

Our Founding Fathers understood the significance of moral values in governance. Their wisdom remains relevant today, serving as a beacon for Christians navigating the complexities of politics. _**Benjamin Franklin,**_ one of the architects of the American Revolution, emphasized the importance of virtuous living in society, stating, _**" Only a virtuous people are capable of freedom." **_This sentiment underscores the indispensable role of morality in preserving liberty and democracy.
_**Thomas Jefferson,**_ author of the Declaration of Independence, recognized the need for divine guidance in the affairs of the nation. He asserted, _**" God who gave us life gave us liberty. And can the liberties of a nation be thought secure when we have removed their only firm basis, a conviction in the minds of the people that these liberties are the gift of God?"**_ Jefferson's words remind us that our rights and freedoms are rooted in God's sovereignty, compelling us to uphold moral principles in our governance.

body:
We’ve got to strengthen our pro-abortion movement ahead of the 2024 election.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1969%2E4032634%2EB_eNjb)
---
I know this is blunt, but I need you to understand this: If Republicans win the White House and control Congress, their federal abortion ban could end abortion protections _**everywhere**_. It won’t matter if you live in a safe, “blue” state when it comes to reproductive rights. It won’t matter if you live in a state that just fought to pass a ballot initiative protecting abortion rights. That’s what this election is coming down to. So I’m going to pull on every lever to fight for the right to an abortion nationwide, like:
* Relentlessly calling out MAGA Republicans’ extremism to defeat them at the ballot box and stop them from banning abortion nationwide.
* Expanding our pro-abortion majority in the Senate and ending the filibuster so we can pass federal abortion protections.
* Reversing the right-wing takeover of our Supreme Court by working to expand and rebalance it.
* Continuing to support local candidates and ballot measures that will defend and organize for abortion rights at the state level. If it makes a difference for just one patient between now and the election, that would be enough.
* Reminding everyone and their mother and their mother’s mother and their father and their father’s best friend and their neighbors that abortion is on the ballot in 2024 — and that’s not just a campaign motto.

[**We’ve got to strengthen our pro-abortion movement ahead of the 2024 election. So if you chip in $25 or more right now, we’ll send you a free “Keep Abortion Legal” pin to say thank you. You can wear it with pride this year to remind everyone what you’re fighting for.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1926?t=8&akid=1969%2E4032634%2EB_eNjb) | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1926?t=9&akid=1969%2E4032634%2EB_eNjb)

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I’m praying that you’ll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **– murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn’t happen to my son, _I wouldn’t even believe it._ **[And I’m praying you will help me save my son](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)** – **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon’s death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence’s legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon’s system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn’t believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**“guilty.”**_

He’s currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they’re trying to put my son – a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations – away for 60 years for something he _didn’t_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** –or LELDF for short.

If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They’re also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)**

**Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence’s team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you – in advance – for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence’s spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note –maybe a prayer?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01vnDAQQH_NcDOyxwOYA4duWfbQzbbaVKpyQsYfWVc4EANa5d9XrNJc3zzNzNNxHoP_aKA6AOIt2AUQQX4DxPeXe0zb3_jjxJJ--cney0ss9il-B8T1Y3Zf6ueW3EUdxp1WbWYb6S2nzDWiEoIXqhQiuzWlGgZH2g81F154xFpUigQJX3BLwmahQY7EJQpELojyGk1JqrZakSIvEYg_7uQ6uhSMFst61ylNU8zNFLOxua3rvDwe6wC7xZktuVy_OTutuwHYjW60HrArvCtr9JZVfJCMjOOsHgrHhKaBlCp0JTXIbltjv0xbMg5ke2hP7Hq8AJY7js6GLYJsj0-fxOg46_D6BrL9H9If2lN_Pp7brn9-Ov_qr8dL__yb_blmqbHzPYxjWMoKiL8-uswU_wUAAP__Tk95VA)** There’s a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you –from the bottom of my heart.

The stakes are too high
Looking ahead to 2024, we're scaling up and preparing to launch an unprecedented grassroots campaign based on the solid groundwork laid in 2022.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
With an expanding team, our efforts continue to grow, but only through your contributions is any of it possible.
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
While some may rely on backroom deals and superficial support to win elections, our focus is where it truly counts: on you, the voters. In recent weeks, our campaign has achieved significant milestones, covering the entire 25,000 square miles of our district, securing nomination signatures from all 36 counties, and reaching out to the new areas, including the sliver of Wexford County added in 2022.
In just the last two weeks, we've engaged with thousands of voters across the political spectrum, all uniting behind Dr. Bob Lorinser's vision for Congress.
While helpful, we understand that television advertisements alone are not enough to secure victory. This election demands a robust, ground-level approach, bridging party lines and fostering deep conversations about our district's challenges. With 190,000 independent voters in our district, Dr. Bob's message is resonating and gaining support.
This campaign is more than a local race; it's crucial for maintaining Joe Biden's presidency, ensuring a Democratic majority in the U.S. Senate, and protecting our democracy for future generations. The stakes are too high for us to sit back.
I invite you to join our cause by volunteering or donating today. Your support is crucial for our success across the board.
Remember, while first-time candidates rarely win, those who persist, like us, stand a much better chance the second time around.
Jack Bergman has yet to face a candidacy like this and knows his seat is at risk.
Let's prove that our commitment can make history.
Join us now.
-Kevin

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1249%2E135344%2EDYiOa1)

Friend --
New polling just dropped in the Michigan Senate race and it shows Elissa virtually tied with former Congressman Mike Rogers. Here’s this morning’s headline:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-2-700&t=2&akid=1249%2E135344%2EDYiOa1)
**[DONATE TO ELISSA](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240321-2-700&t=3&akid=1249%2E135344%2EDYiOa1)**
The poll finds Elissa with 41% and Rogers with 39% -- a slight edge, but within the margin of error. And 20% of voters are undecided -- a key group we still need to reach before the election.
Another key piece of data we’re looking at in this poll: When paired with the other potential GOP nominees, Sandy Pensler, Justin Amash, and Peter Meijer, we see a similar dynamic -- Elissa leading, but with a LOT of people who still haven’t made up their minds and could shift the course of this election.
Odds are, you’re getting a lot of emails and texts from other campaigns, asking you to make a contribution.
Every race is important. But public polls like this one show that few will be closer than our race here in Michigan. And with not only control of the Senate, but also the White House hanging in the balance, few will be more impactful.
Here’s the thing: National Republicans see the same polling we do. And they know how important Michigan is. They’re prepared to spend big to beat us, so we need to be campaigning hard from start to finish.
If we don’t--if we fall behind--it will be even harder to catch back up. That’s where people like you come in. Each week and each month, we have fundraising goals we need to meet to fund a winning campaign.
So we ask:
[**Will you chip in $3, or whatever you can, to Elissa Slotkin’s campaign for Senate in Michigan? This is going to be one of the most competitive, pivotal—and expensive—races in the nation. Today, Lt. Gov. Flanagan and I visited a local school to support a bill DFL leaders in the legislature introduced to prevent book bans in public and school libraries based on ideology. We know where Republicans stand on this issue. In the first half of the 2022-23 school year, there were over 1,400 instances of attempted GOP book bans across the country. Peter, let me be clear: As long as I’m governor, we will never let a book ban happen in Minnesota. Censorship has no place in our schools and libraries, and it certainly has no place in our democracy. Taking books away from kids and schools does not protect our children, but it does erase many of the stories and voices that do. This legislation will ensure books remain accessible to teach and all children continue to have the opportunity to read freely. Thank you for making your voice heard. I’m grateful, Tim Walz

** We don't want to worry you, but...
------------------------------------------------------------

Politics is often unpleasant, as my opponent DA Mike Schmidt demonstrated recently. He hamstrung a forum on crime and public safety that he had long agreed to participate in because he didn’t want to face any tough questions. So after pulling out and strong-arming us out of the forum, he instead chose to run intentionally misleading attack ads against Nathan on the channel that was to be airing the forum.

Here is the introduction to the event, where his absence is explained:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4i6CNdSaQQk&utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=657a99205e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Help Nathan Vasquez Fight Back (https://www.cesystems.tech/campaign/vasquezvotevasquez/?referral=email-3-12&utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=657a99205e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Television ads aren’t cheap, but they’re necessary when your opponent is running them. We need funds to get the message out about how Schmidt is failing Multnomah County with his policies, and how Nathan will ensure that justice will be served and criminals won’t go unpunished.

Nathan is doing his best to get his message out to every voter he can, via any venue he can. We need to know that you’ll have his back and support him.

body:
An absolute disaster, to say the least| | |
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=4755782e66cb4ceda84cbd0df3c7c061&_e=ZvGglB9zgqWTTCRJ2Nsv6LVOUhmJUmUPgMxjap4DGWRsGn0gGfF3CqGIX2oRaWH2WdRQFZequgncqUxX8-_zPTzQ4WiYIBNjA7JDNXrAtouStTt3F-YFolgRrwVe9zSFwrCJ-q197clh0j1Symw5P9-7y-E8RvZ4f8SP3dBNYGfFn6oBCxGW5ZXKh9DXvMtoaH7jz1PR5AaqxDzaKyqtLA%3D%3D)
---
Friend If you haven’t heard yet, Joe Biden is trying to make it so that in the next decade, two-thirds of all vehicles sold in the US must be electric vehicles.
---
[**READ ARTICLE**](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=4755782e66cb4ceda84cbd0df3c7c061&_e=ZvGglB9zgqWTTCRJ2Nsv6Pdo_PzIHGzPWI36Udfx6MKL7-GAC2DHImrp0d5S4b9QGkZAo4ZE6KVihKgM3rU95M15p2HIYwlqFbVRzHt5IP1izs7K9zB_ghJfCuCJkTPiYd2hk37ClfQLdykiwC-OUTbJB1vruh1-i4iwsF7t_Zt4ndgybfZUz4e3Wj_5ZGSoSyMOVwUIP5SNAH869X1lF-qd_ygqZCNhH9E1EfMOsl0uhmmGByaRTJV6zBIrAlOxWkntjkaYyNJ08S1IovuzXDDwE991W6COtr1-xXf_PlJRqZ3LjrIabbALehBnk83KQE37a6h456qJ-jE2DymBzKTXD7jdrOR0SOJpINi4TGQfeQlqaD4W2mvYMnfX6upp)
---
And Mike Rogers’ likely Democrat opponent, Elissa Slotkin, is standing right there with Joe, as she always does. Dear Friend, I hope this message finds you in a fighting spirit because that's precisely what we need right now. I'm not going to mince words: I'm mad as hell. The talking heads and political elite have written off West Virginia, saying it's a lost cause for Democrats. But I'm here to call their bluff. Remember Bernie Sanders? In the 2016 primaries, he showed us something incredible - when a candidate truly stands up for the working folks, West Virginia listens. Bernie's message resonated here because he spoke about the real struggles we face every day. It wasn't about left or right; it was about right and wrong. That's the fight I'm bringing to this Senate race. I'm not your polished, suit-wearing politician. **I come from the same hardworking background as you. I've faced the same struggles, and I'm fed up with being ignored by those who claim to represent us. It's time for one of our own to stand up and fight back.**

It's about taking a stand for our dignity, for our jobs, and for our families. It's about showing the country that West Virginia won't be pigeonholed or written off. I'm ready to fight this battle but can't do it alone. I need you with me. **[Every dollar you can spare, every hour you can volunteer, brings us closer to proving them all wrong.
